It’s a mental image of where I’d like to be in the New Year and it more or less works for me, I obviously don’t go around writing ‘Aston Martins’ in my list because that shit holds no importance to me – UBER is just fine thank you!  What would you put in your list? I’d love to know!I’m going to be home with Mom, Dad & Naina for New Year’s Eve playing Ludo, eating more than required, bingeing on sugar, wine and also breaking open this new card game I bought recently – Exploding Kittens. Have you heard of it? It’s supposed to be really popular apparently.Anyway! I hope each and every one of you has a lovely New Year and enters 2018 with fresh minds, bodies and souls. Always take out time for yourself, work will always be there to get back to, spend time with family because nobody knows how much more time you have with them. Hold your loved ones tight, tell them you love them and smile. Happy New Year Everyone!                                                      I’m all about the sequins. I was also excited to learn that the ‘Luxe Bridge’ store in Ambience Mall now stocks Marc Jacobs accessories – that includes bags for now and sunglasses soon too. I went ahead and picked out a Marc Jacobs bag that, if you look at the pics of my outfit, looks like it was made just for the dress that I’m wearing. They both look so good together!I did this quick shoot when I went over to Prateeq’s place yesterday to catch up over some wine and Netflix. The ‘some’ wine turned into 2 bottles of wine (full disclosure – there were more people drinking) and we went on to play some game called ‘Psych’ on our smartphones like complete millennials. It was fun though.I stopped making New Year Resolutions many years back because you can do that any day of the year. But I do, always, make a little list where I write down the things I will have in the next year – as a mental declaration to myself (so that I subconsciously work towards it). And I think it’s important to focus on the things you will want to have, not the things that you want to avoid – give weightage to the positives, not the negatives. It’s a mental image of where I’d like to be in the New Year and it more or less works for me, I obviously don’t go around writing ‘Aston Martins’ in my list because that shit holds no importance to me – UBER is just fine thank you!  What would you put in your list? I’d love to know!I’m going to be home with Mom, Dad & Naina for New Year’s Eve playing Ludo, eating more than required, bingeing on sugar, wine and also breaking open this new card game I bought recently – Exploding Kittens. Have you heard of it? It’s supposed to be really popular apparently.Anyway! I hope each and every one of you has a lovely New Year and enters 2018 with fresh minds, bodies and souls. Always take out time for yourself, work will always be there to get back to, spend time with family because nobody knows how much more time you have with them. Hold your loved ones tight, tell them you love them and smile. Happy New Year Everyone!                                                      Hope you enjoyed the post! It’s so frustrating when I see articles and lists of ‘rules’ that you need to be aware of in fashion. Wear this, don’t wear that. It’s so subjective, what I like, the second person may completely despise for their own reasons – heck my own mother finds my middle hair parting repulsive. When it comes to fashion, I have always been vocal about not being very fond of trends or never being interested in following them – and I still stick to it – why must one take fashion so seriously – they’re clothes and outfits and you only need to be comfortable and have fun with it. It’s so frustrating when I see articles and lists of ‘rules’ that you need to be aware of in fashion. Wear this, don’t wear that. When it comes to fashion, I have always been vocal about not being very fond of trends or never being interested in following them – and I still stick to it – why must one take fashion so seriously – they’re clothes and outfits and you only need to be comfortable and have fun with it. It’s so frustrating when I see articles and lists of ‘rules’ that you need to be aware of in fashion. Wear this, don’t wear that. It’s so subjective, what I like, the second person may completely despise for their own reasons – heck my own mother finds my middle hair parting repulsive. But that didn’t stop me from keeping a middle parting ALL THE TIME for a year straight! I always got nagged for it – but I loved how different it made me look (and I also got a LOT of support and love from a lot of you guys! So it kept me going heh). Accessories can just be statement earrings and a great pair of heels or comfy juttis and you’re set to celebrate Diwali in your festive best.Hope everyone has a lovely day! Peace and light to all!                                          The festive season is in full swing and I wanted to bring in Diwali with this lovely Indian outfit courtesy Soch.in Soch opened it’s first store in 2005 in Bengaluru and has gained loyal customers and a strong holding ever since. You will find a large variety of Indianwear along with casual kurtis, full salwaar kameez sets (like what I’m wearing), sarees and even a well curated range of western-wear. When you visit their website there is a sense of elegance that you will find running through not only in their layout but also the outfits they offer – nothing gaudy, flashy or shabby. The brand image has been well thought of and executed and that is why I particularly like it. Details at the end of the post as always.Get ready for a beautiful summer day of shopping ladies and discover & support Indian designers from across the country on the 12th at Fashion Capsule! I recently visited the restaurant Sorrento at Shangri-La’s Eros Hotel in New Delhi to experience their new healthy Italian ‘Au Naturel’ menu which was exceptionally refreshing and light. Specially curated by Executive Chef Neeraj Tyagi, who is under training by Michelin Star Chef Florent Boivin from the institute of Paul Bocuse in Lyon, this menu features options that will delight your palate and keep you feeling light and healthy.  Straying from the typical healthy salads and stir-fried dishes, the menu has been infused with a touch of decadence, which is evident in gourmet dishes such as the Atlantic crab salad, poached lobster, summer vegetable salad and potato ravioli, as well as others. It was a beautiful lunch with perfect Delhi weather for a change. So whatever kind of wedding you have in mind, you’ll be sure to find beautiful options in the Rivaah Collection by TanishqI went ahead and picked out a few of my favorite pieces from the collection that you will see in this blog post. It took some time because the collection is spread across 2 different storeys in their store! What I also loved about a lot of the pieces in the collection was how versatile they are – not only are they meant for the bride to be worn on her wedding day but they can also be worn for other different functions, paired with different outfits and some of them can even be worn with western outfits for a special occasion. No more do you have to be bothered by spending your money on jewelry that you can only wear once. You can now go for pieces that you’ll be able to wear again and again and look absolutely stunning doing so.The Rivaah Collection, being such a large one, has sets ranging from light, delicate ones to elaborate, heavy ones and everything in between so you are sure to find something for your budget. It’s a very simple, basic striped dress in a stretchy jersey material and the easiest of silhouettes that make it easy to move around in. Super comfy. With it I was carrying my new delicious genuine leather backpack by Outback. In supple full-grain leather, a separate cushioned compartment for my laptop which I carry on me for pretty much all my trips, and more space that fit in my DSLR, laptop cables, cellphone charger, a tennis ball, hand sanitizer, a scarf and a pair of sunglasses. There are a lot of pockets and compartments for people who have an organizing tick like me which is why I LOVE this Backpack. It’s roomy and this tan shade is so classic, this backpack may even look hipster-chic with office-wear. The wide selection includes Benarasi from Uttar Pradesh, Chikankari from Lucknow, Kalamkari from Andhra Pradesh, Maheshwari from Madhya Pradesh, Handblock Print from Rajasthan, Bandhani from Gujarat along with eclectic crafts like Patola, Madhubani, Kantha, Chanderi in clothing, Terracotta & Meenakari in jewellery, Kutchi bags, Dhurries & Dhokra in home & kitchen categories sourced directly from large organized brands like Jaypore, Indusdiva, Fabindia, Unnati Silks and brands like Craftisan, Kilol, Caravan and more.I put together this beautiful outfit from the Handloom Store and I think it’s going to be my favorite look from all 4 days. Instant love for this ‘Dabu’ printed dress by Jaypore. It is a blend of silk & cotton and made from hand block printed textile. Dabu is a ‘mud resist’ block printing technique in which a thick viscous paste made of clay, lime, tree gum and insect eaten wheat is used in a printing process to resist the desired pattern from dyeing colors. native to rajasthan, dabu printing is now practiced in just a few clusters like the village of akola. A light breezy dress with summery layers paired with a silk wool handloom stole (also by Jaypore) in a brilliant green (this color is already sold out but you can find different colors as well). It’s true! And I didn’t carry any blow-dryer, hair-irons etc.– Just how much I love my sleep. And this is a big big lesson. I was so sleep deprived when we reached home that I didn’t get out of my bed for 2 days for anything other than the essentials.– That it’s totally acceptable to not bathe for 4 days straight just as long as you keep your lady parts clean. I did bathe on one of those days though but that was only because I had a work shoot. Boo! There, I said it.– Music festivals are probably the only place where you don’t totally hate humans in general coz somehow no-one seems to want to behave like a complete asshole. While I happen to be a total summer girl – love the heat, don’t mind the sweat, can even live without any air conditioning, I don’t acutely hate the cold weather provided it’s bearable. This, right now, in Delhi, is not bearable by my standards. And I truly detest it. Sunny days are a solace and my only window to look like I actually put some thought into my outfit instead of my standard 2 layers of warm inners covered with whatever since that’s anyway going to get covered further with my biggest fluffiest down feather jacket, so why bother.I also have never been a fan of spending too much time on deciding what I should wear so I form a mini collection of permutations and combinations that spend a larger part of my winters in. I’m showing you a few of my winter essentials in today’s outfit – each piece a versatile piece on it’s own that can be worn with lots of other things.The Long Grey Pullover I love it mostly because of the grey color and the texture it has. It definitely doesn’t do anything to keep you warm since it’s cotton so I absolutely have an inner under that.Blue Denim Jeans The thicker the fabric the better (warmer it will keep you). But I have started liking the stretchy ones more than the rugged ones because the latter just seems too suffocating now.A Large Leather Bag I’m not entirely sure why but my space requirements in a carry bag/purse increase significantly in the colder months as compared to the summers. This genuine leather Phive Rivers bag in a ‘Midnight Blue’ color fits everything I could possibly want to carry on my person and then some. Love the croc print on it and the fact that is it handcrafted by 5 artisans! The brand also comes out with new styles every 30-40 days!Black Booties Classics again.Quirky Sunglasses In your dreary, colorless winter outfit it should be made mandatory to have one element/accessory that stands out and makes you seem less dead inside. I had named my little cactus Bubsters but he recently died while I was away for New Year. I think it was because I left him under direct sunlight and forgot him there. Sorry Bubsters! I miss you!       However, if you can’t even take care of cacti, there is still hope for you. Like these cacti candles. Whaaaaa! These look so good! Imagine them lit up with low lighting in the room for an evening. Classy!       I’m crazy about anything cactus right now so this wallpaper look super fine too! Love the boring black and white where the cactus gives it a completely fun feel.       Talking about wallpapers, polka dots give a retro, fun and smart look too. Tip – all the dots shouldn’t be the same size, have them of different sizes to add some mystery and interest.       Or perhaps have watercolor paint on your wall for a mystic feel? I’m not sure whether you can DIY this successfully but you sure can try. Looks so nautical and moody! Neon signs may not give off the classiest vibes but who cares, you like it, you take it. And I love it! I probably would switch it off when I go to sleep but I’d love to have it on all during the day. Haah!       Another love for lights is through these fairy lights. I have seen a lot of pics like these where people clip up photographs on the trail of lights and it looks so cosy and inviting. But, since this seems a lot more personal I would limit this to just the bedroom (for your own private space)       Mirrors! Gotta love them. Especially if you are a blogger! Or not! Loved this quirky DIY for people who like to keep things interesting. Shove in mirrors into your old tennis racquets. So vintage and definitely a conversation starter if you tend to be a shy hostess lol!       I’m also really into ‘text’ written on stuff. Especially when it’s positive, fun, cozy and in cursive. On pillows, cushions, doormats, mugs and whatever else you can find. These cushions really do put a smile on your face.       And this welcome mat truly is welcoming. Have a look:If you are not too confident of having such a huge plant you can opt for smaller potted ones with huge leaves for a similar effect. Love this idea of putting the plant on a tiny stool to add more height and character.       A matte grey pot for green plants looks really good too.       I also love the idea of breaking your white walls with intermittent creeper plants in the room. Don’t these look cute? I love plain white walls too but this adds more interest visually.       Copper or metallic pots are another rage. Not only are metallics in trend everywhere else like fashion and beauty but using just one metallic element like this within the green and white elements in the room looks so darn good!       This obviously won’t last very long but looks equally good and classy and is an ideal way to spruce up your living room if you have guests coming over – put a big leaf in water in a smooth big glass bowl. Chic and clean.       If you, like me lack a green thumb, cacti are your saviours (very good looking ones might I add). Plus they help make all your flatlay shoots look so good. I had named my little cactus Bubsters but he recently died while I was away for New Year. I think it was because I left him under direct sunlight and forgot him there. Sorry Bubsters! I miss you!       However, if you can’t even take care of cacti, there is still hope for you. Like these cacti candles. Whaaaaa! These look so good! Imagine them lit up with low lighting in the room for an evening. Classy!       I’m crazy about anything cactus right now so this wallpaper look super fine too! Love the boring black and white where the cactus gives it a completely fun feel.       Talking about wallpapers, polka dots give a retro, fun and smart look too. Tip – all the dots shouldn’t be the same size, have them of different sizes to add some mystery and interest.       Or perhaps have watercolor paint on your wall for a mystic feel? I’m not sure whether you can DIY this successfully but you sure can try. Looks so nautical and moody!       While I know you don’t really need fireplaces in a shitty place like Delhi, I didn’t want to limit myself. Just look at this! Don’t you want to be sitting in that chair RIGHT NOW!       Neon signs may not give off the classiest vibes but who cares, you like it, you take it. And I love it! I probably would switch it off when I go to sleep but I’d love to have it on all during the day. Haah!       Another love for lights is through these fairy lights. I have seen a lot of pics like these where people clip up photographs on the trail of lights and it looks so cosy and inviting. But, since this seems a lot more personal I would limit this to just the bedroom (for your own private space)       Mirrors! Gotta love them. Especially if you are a blogger! Or not! Someone recently commented on one of my blog posts – ‘Some of your poses are a bit ridiculous’. I replied with a ‘Thanks!’ Mirrors will definitely help you get your poses right, if you tend to give a fuck about what other people may or may not think of them. Just saying! This mirror is bae!       Circular mirrors are super chic too! And look at that romantic rosy vintage wallpaper. This is called bathroom perfection my friends.       Loved this quirky DIY for people who like to keep things interesting. Shove in mirrors into your old tennis racquets. So vintage and definitely a conversation starter if you tend to be a shy hostess lol!       I’m also really into ‘text’ written on stuff. Especially when it’s positive, fun, cozy and in cursive. On pillows, cushions, doormats, mugs and whatever else you can find. These cushions really do put a smile on your face.       And this welcome mat truly is welcoming.       I am aware that being in Delhi, something like this, more than being unfeasible is probably stupid because hey, you live in India, we have dust and pollution here but I still couldn’t help myself. I think we all have a boho-hippie-goddess somewhere inside us who wants to hang her pretty dresses from a rustic tree branch like this in the middle of her room. No?       You gotta have bathtub, I mean…ofcourse!       Another way to include metallic in your room – a rustic bronze cupboard or cabinet like this. But remember, just one. More than that and you’ll look too desperate.        All images have been taken from Pinterest. To get to their original source please click on the images in Pinterest. I was recently caught in a situation where I had to be out for meetings right from the morning after which I had to rush to an engagement-lunch of a relative and had no time whatsoever to get changed for it (much against my Mom’s desires!). So I did what any woman facing a time crunch would do – multitask. But in this case I multi-tasked my outfit instead. I went for a look that was appropriate for my meetings and would be acceptable at a day wedding engagement as well (luckily it was a day-time occasion so I was able to get away with it). I picked out a simple yet comfortable kurta + churidar, both from the brand ‘Myx’ available on Amazon Fashion. Kept some jewelry to wear for the engagement in my bag and paired the look with booties coz heaven knows I’ll have to murder someone if I have to send more than 5 minutes in heels. Went for a slightly ‘Indianesque’ hand-made leather + wood bag by Swarang Designs and voila! I’m as ready to face the day as I can be!The stretchy churidars are my favorite kind, easy to wear, easy to move around in, no risk of them tearing at their seams when I sit down (yes that’s happened to me more than once), no hooks to manage at the end of my unreachable legs and they do give a great shape to the legs if I’m being honest. It’s been quite some time since we were whisked away to a beautiful stay in Agra by Salvatore Ferragamo for the launch of their lovely new ‘Cuore‘ watch in India and I had some lovely pics of the experience that I HAD to share with you. Our stay was arranged at the brilliant Oberoi Amarvilas, which was also the venue for the official launch event followed by a gala dinner and I have photographs of it all (lots of them so have fun browsing!)We started off with a road trip to the hotel in Agra where we were treated to immaculate hospitality and spectacular views of the Taj Mahal right from our room, where we rested and got ready for the exciting evening. The Cuore watch has been created by Salvatore Ferragamo as a perfect accessory and an ideal gift of love for a special occasion like an anniversary or even the birthday of a loved one. And what sets it apart is the steel heart inside the dial which “beats” once a second as its two halves separate and then reunite, driven by a patented device. The secret is an innovative quartz movement, designed and manufactured exclusively for Salvatore Ferragamo. Pressing the crown starts the function, while the time is set with a button at 2 o’clock using a special heart-shaped tool. It truly is a special and mesmerising object and I have managed to fascinate everybody I know closely with my Cuore Ferragamo and it’s beating heart. I’m in LOVE! I went for a classic black calfskin strap and I love the fact that the women’s dial is not as tiny as they usually are in other brands – I have always been a fan of large dials which is why I’m more fond of men’s watches than women’s, but the Cuore Ferragamo has a really perfect dial size which is not too small, not too big, magnificently heavy/solid and completely classy.It’s been quite some time since we were whisked away to a beautiful stay in Agra by Salvatore Ferragamo for the launch of their lovely new ‘Cuore‘ watch in India and I had some lovely pics of the experience that I HAD to share with you. I went for a classic black calfskin strap and I love the fact that the women’s dial is not as tiny as they usually are in other brands – I have always been a fan of large dials which is why I’m more fond of men’s watches than women’s, but the Cuore Ferragamo has a really perfect dial size which is not too small, not too big, magnificently heavy/solid and completely classy.Cuore Ferragamo is available with a bi-colour bracelet or a crocodile print calfskin strap in one of a sophisticated palette of colour shades: yellow, black, red, purple, pink and grey. The Cuore watch has been created by Salvatore Ferragamo as a perfect accessory and an ideal gift of love for a special occasion like an anniversary or even the birthday of a loved one. And what sets it apart is the steel heart inside the dial which “beats” once a second as its two halves separate and then reunite, driven by a patented device. Now that the Amazon India Fashion Week Spring Summer 2017 is over and you have seen my outfits for all 5 days with Amazon as my official Fashion Partner, I would love to take you through a typical day for me at fashion week as a blogger/influencer and what is it that I mostly am doing with my time there. All along my two most important accessories are my camera and my smartphone and this time I have partnered with Coolpad India to get me through #AIFWSS17 with their new smartphone – Coolpad Note 5. So here goes.                  I usually arrive during late afternoon when there are fewer people and the day is still a bit sluggish. This gives me time and space to do do my ourtit shoot which I share with you daily throughout Fashion Week. A different look each day.      Sometimes you end up making a new friend during the shoot too.      By the time I’m done with my shoot the pace for the day has picked up. There are lot more people and the general buzz and energy levels of the venue have gone up. Since fashion week is such a hotspot for the fashion & textile industry related professionals, I am always running into friends, acquaintances, clients and PR professionals and it’s almost a mandate to take a selfie after you have said hello. It’s kinda like the new handshake but somehow not as polished as a handshake. It’s kinda like the new handshake but somehow not as polished as a handshake. But you still gotta do it.Saying hello to Rasna Bhasin – influencer and at Bazaar Bride      The selfie from the Coolpad Note 5      Saying hello to Pranav & Shyma – the designers at Huemn      The selfie from the Coolpad Note 5      Then I usually attend a few runway shows from the day. Here I’m seated for the Mandira Wirk show and well it’s time to take another selfie. It’s quite dark inside the show area so having a led flash for your selfie camera inbuilt in the smartphone itself is GODSENT! You can adjust the distance of the camera from your face to decide how strong you want the flash light to be because it’s continuously on like a torch (it doesn’t just go off when the pic is being clicked) – another plus.      After the show, I head over to Mandira Wirk’s stall at the venue to get a closer look at her collection. It’s always a good idea to get a touch & feel of the collection, see the details and embellishments and truly get a chance to appreciate all the work that has gone in.      If you manage to find time, you grab a bite, reply to some emails (thank you for the open WiFi this time!) and make a few important phone calls.      While you’re walking around, you almost always get stopped by someone who either wants to take a pic of your outfit or a detail of your outfit, or a quick byte on some designer’s collection, or a boomerang video or a full on interview.      And because I end up being in front of the camera a lot, I make it a point to check if my make is point, needs any retouching or not. Nothing major but mainly either retouching my lipstick or blotting the extra oil off the skin. The selfie camera (without the beautification filter)  on the Notepad 5 acts as my mirror wherever I go. No need to make a trip to the washrooms just to get access to a mirror.      Et voila! Perfect Red Lips.      Before you know it the sun has disappeared, it’s dark and the lights have come on everywhere making everything look so much more magical and festive! They had installed this huge AIFW bulb sign right at the entry to the venue and it instantly became one of the most clicked objects during the #AIFWSS17 this time. And it looks so much better at night with the lights on! Had to get a selfie with it too!            A few shows more perhaps and it’s time to call it a day. In the past I used to do a lot more during fashion week – pre-show parties, after parties and a lot more shows! And can’t quite comprehend where I managed to create that kind of energy and willpower. But now it’s a lot more about work for me. So once I know I have my content for the day, It’s time for me to head back home, start editing photographs, content, drafting blog posts. reshare social media posts in which I have been featured and also have dinner (most important). It sounds a bit non-glamorous and maybe it even is, but it’s real, it’s work, it’s fun and it makes me money! Not to mention, it allows to get my beauty sleep  So cheers to everyone who is a part of the fashion industry! And see you next season! Not to mention, it allows to get my beauty sleep  So cheers to everyone who is a part of the fashion industry! And see you next season! Which means I did not have to carry a powerbank on a single day of fashion week and those things can sometimes get too big or heavy for the tiny bags I have picked out for my looks. So here goes.                  I usually arrive during late afternoon when there are fewer people and the day is still a bit sluggish. This gives me time and space to do do my ourtit shoot which I share with you daily throughout Fashion Week. A different look each day.      Sometimes you end up making a new friend during the shoot too.      By the time I’m done with my shoot the pace for the day has picked up. There are lot more people and the general buzz and energy levels of the venue have gone up. Since fashion week is such a hotspot for the fashion & textile industry related professionals, I am always running into friends, acquaintances, clients and PR professionals and it’s almost a mandate to take a selfie after you have said hello. It’s kinda like the new handshake but somehow not as polished as a handshake. But you still gotta do it.Saying hello to Rasna Bhasin – influencer and at Bazaar Bride      The selfie from the Coolpad Note 5      Saying hello to Pranav & Shyma – the designers at Huemn      The selfie from the Coolpad Note 5      Then I usually attend a few runway shows from the day. Here I’m seated for the Mandira Wirk show and well it’s time to take another selfie. It’s quite dark inside the show area so having a led flash for your selfie camera inbuilt in the smartphone itself is GODSENT! You can adjust the distance of the camera from your face to decide how strong you want the flash light to be because it’s continuously on like a torch (it doesn’t just go off when the pic is being clicked) – another plus.      After the show, I head over to Mandira Wirk’s stall at the venue to get a closer look at her collection. It’s always a good idea to get a touch & feel of the collection, see the details and embellishments and truly get a chance to appreciate all the work that has gone in.      If you manage to find time, you grab a bite, reply to some emails (thank you for the open WiFi this time!) and make a few important phone calls.      While you’re walking around, you almost always get stopped by someone who either wants to take a pic of your outfit or a detail of your outfit, or a quick byte on some designer’s collection, or a boomerang video or a full on interview.      And because I end up being in front of the camera a lot, I make it a point to check if my make is point, needs any retouching or not. Nothing major but mainly either retouching my lipstick or blotting the extra oil off the skin. The selfie camera (without the beautification filter)  on the Notepad 5 acts as my mirror wherever I go. No need to make a trip to the washrooms just to get access to a mirror.      Et voila! Perfect Red Lips.      Before you know it the sun has disappeared, it’s dark and the lights have come on everywhere making everything look so much more magical and festive! They had installed this huge AIFW bulb sign right at the entry to the venue and it instantly became one of the most clicked objects during the #AIFWSS17 this time. And it looks so much better at night with the lights on! Had to get a selfie with it too!            A few shows more perhaps and it’s time to call it a day. In the past I used to do a lot more during fashion week – pre-show parties, after parties and a lot more shows! And can’t quite comprehend where I managed to create that kind of energy and willpower. But now it’s a lot more about work for me. It sounds a bit non-glamorous and maybe it even is, but it’s real, it’s work, it’s fun and it makes me money! As…Now that the Amazon India Fashion Week Spring Summer 2017 is over and you have seen my outfits for all 5 days with Amazon as my official Fashion Partner, I would love to take you through a typical day for me at fashion week as a blogger/influencer and what is it that I mostly am doing with my time there. All along my two most important accessories are my camera and my smartphone and this time I have partnered with Coolpad India to get me through #AIFWSS17 with their new smartphone – Coolpad Note 5. So here goes.                  I usually arrive during late afternoon when there are fewer people and the day is still a bit sluggish. This gives me time and space to do do my ourtit shoot which I share with you daily throughout Fashion Week. A different look each day.      Sometimes you end up making a new friend during the shoot too.      By the time I’m done with my shoot the pace for the day has picked up. There are lot more people and the general buzz and energy levels of the venue have gone up. Since fashion week is such a hotspot for the fashion & textile industry related professionals, I am always running into friends, acquaintances, clients and PR professionals and it’s almost a mandate to take a selfie after you have said hello. It’s kinda like the new handshake but somehow not as polished as a handshake. But you still gotta do it.Saying hello to Rasna Bhasin – influencer and at Bazaar Bride      The selfie from the Coolpad Note 5      Saying hello to Pranav & Shyma – the designers at Huemn      The selfie from the Coolpad Note 5      Then I usually attend a few runway shows from the day. Here I’m seated for the Mandira Wirk show and well it’s time to take another selfie. It’s quite dark inside the show area so having a led flash for your selfie camera inbuilt in the smartphone itself is GODSENT! You can adjust the distance of the camera from your face to decide how strong you want the flash light to be because it’s continuously on like a torch (it doesn’t just go off when the pic is being clicked) – another plus.      After the show, I head over to Mandira Wirk’s stall at the venue to get a closer look at her collection. It’s always a good idea to get a touch & feel of the collection, see the details and embellishments and truly get a chance to appreciate all the work that has gone in.      If you manage to find time, you grab a bite, reply to some emails (thank you for the open WiFi this time!) and make a few important phone calls.      While you’re walking around, you almost always get stopped by someone who either wants to take a pic of your outfit or a detail of your outfit, or a quick byte on some designer’s collection, or a boomerang video or a full on interview.      And because I end up being in front of the camera a lot, I make it a point to check if my make is point, needs any retouching or not. Nothing major but mainly either retouching my lipstick or blotting the extra oil off the skin. The selfie camera (without the beautification filter)  on the Notepad 5 acts as my mirror wherever I go. No need to make a trip to the washrooms just to get access to a mirror.      Et voila! Perfect Red Lips.      Before you know it the sun has disappeared, it’s dark and the lights have come on everywhere making everything look so much more magical and festive! They had installed this huge AIFW bulb sign right at the entry to the venue and it instantly became one of the most clicked objects during the #AIFWSS17 this time. And it looks so much better at night with the lights on! Had to get a selfie with it too!            A few shows more perhaps and it’s time to call it a day. In the past I used to do a lot more during fashion week – pre-show parties, after parties and a lot more shows! And can’t quite comprehend where I managed to create that kind of energy and willpower. But now it’s a lot more about work for me. So once I know I have my content for the day, It’s time for me to head back home, start editing photographs, content, drafting blog posts. reshare social media posts in which I have been featured and also have dinner (most important). It sounds a bit non-glamorous and maybe it even is, but it’s real, it’s work, it’s fun and it makes me money! Not to mention, it allows to get my beauty sleep  So cheers to everyone who is a part of the fashion industry! And see you next season! It’s most impressive because after ALL of this above and more, the device has enough juice left right till the time I go to sleep after wrapping up everything for the day. Which means I did not have to carry a powerbank on a single day of fashion week and those things can sometimes get too big or heavy for the tiny bags I have picked out for my looks. And it looks so much better at night with the lights on! Had to get a selfie with it too!            A few shows more perhaps and it’s time to call it a day. In the past I used to do a lot more during fashion week – pre-show parties, after parties and a lot more shows! And can’t quite comprehend where I managed to create that kind of energy and willpower. But now it’s a lot more about work for me. So once I know I have my content for the day, It’s time for me to head back home, start editing photographs, content, drafting blog posts. reshare social media posts in which I have been featured and also have dinner (most important). It sounds a bit non-glamorous and maybe it even is, but it’s real, it’s work, it’s fun and it makes me money! Not to mention, it allows to get my beauty sleep  So cheers to everyone who is a part of the fashion industry! And see you next season!      A big thank you to Coolpad for letting me experience the Notepad 5 during the Fashion Week and really put it to test. It’s most impressive because after ALL of this above and more, the device has enough juice left right till the time I go to sleep after wrapping up everything for the day. Which means I did not have to carry a powerbank on a single day of fashion week and those things can sometimes get too big or heavy for the tiny bags I have picked out for my looks. Well, atleast a statement on a tee! ‘Not A Fashion Victim’. I’m not really sure why term term ‘Fashion Victim’ even exists in the first place. Being such a personal choice, fashion can never really have victims. As long as you are comfortable and confident in what you’re wearing. Yes perhaps it was coined for people who fall victim to following trends (whatever that even means anymore) even if it doesn’t suit them or makes them feel unnatural. This tee is for the people who love fashion, even if they don’t know why, aren’t afraid to try new things and those who certainly don’t give two bat shits about what somebody else will think about their outfit. Yes perhaps it was coined for people who fall victim to following trends (whatever that even means anymore) even if it doesn’t suit them or makes them feel unnatural. This tee is for the people who love fashion, even if they don’t know why, aren’t afraid to try new things and those who certainly don’t give two bat shits about what somebody else will think about their outfit. Love yourself and embrace yourself. It exists to please you, not make a mockery out of you – Fashion.My look is again so simple with just a cute little black skirt that would give my tee all the attention it needs, with black and white sneakers from Day 03 and an #IndiaModernFestive element of chandbalis to make you suddenly go ‘wait what?!’This has been a great season and I’m already looking forward to the next one. Tomorrow I leave for a exciting trip to Geneva & Milan with Glion Institute of Higher Education! They have a bunch of exciting experiences that await me along with a few other bloggers from different parts of the world. I will be gone for 10 days and I have no time to pack or even gather my thoughts. It’s busy, it’s hectic, it drives me crazy but at the end of the day I LOVE what I do and I wouldn’t have it any other way! There is a lot more stuff coming on the blog coming week so stay tuned! Till next season, it’s a wrap with the Amazon India Fashion Week!                                                      Ending the Amazon India Fashion Week Spring Summer 2017 with a statement. Day 04 of Amazon India Fashion Week Spring Summer 2017 is over! One more day to go! You’re kinda done with it but not quite yet. Which is why I decided to keep it super simple today at #AIFWSS17 with just a cute little element of fun in my outfit – Red Lips! Not just my own but also lots of them on my white sweatshirt. Having Amazon Fashion as my Official Fashion Partner this season has really made me a pro at picking out looks and putting them together quicker than I used to be able to 6 months back. I paired my cute sweatshirt with a pair of extremely comfy, loose, couchy blue boyfriend jeans, the suede sneakers that I wore on Day 01 and a matching Fendi bag. That’s it really. Having Amazon Fashion as my Official Fashion Partner this season has really made me a pro at picking out looks and putting them together quicker than I used to be able to 6 months back. I paired my cute sweatshirt with a pair of extremely comfy, loose, couchy blue boyfriend jeans, the suede sneakers that I wore on Day 01 and a matching Fendi bag. That’s it really. No fuss, no frills (except in the bag), no fancy (non-workable-in-real-life) outfits – just a good look with a quirky twist to keep a conversation running incase you’re left with nothing else to talk about. And honestly who doesn’t like red lips?! Hope you enjoy this outfit from Day 04. Coz it was Day 02 of the Amazon India Fashion Week SS17 and you kinda need that sugar rush to keep you going (or maybe an espresso shot. Or 10). I just had the worse timing of getting two of my teeth extracted (one normal and one wisdom) just 2 days before the #AIFWSS17 was to start. Now I’m left with stitches in my mouth, and the look of a total grumpy face because I can’t smile properly or even talk too much – no food or alcohol can also be consumed either (only soft and cold foods and a diet of antibiotics and painkillers). But it was one those things that I had been delaying for over 8 months and if I hadn’t gotten it done when I did, I would have had to suffer another 8 because I just cannot get myself to visit a dentist. So if you see me at Fashion Week and I don’t smile back at you or smile really weird, you’ll know why.Candy candy candy! Now I’m left with stitches in my mouth, and the look of a total grumpy face because I can’t smile properly or even talk too much – no food or alcohol can also be consumed either (only soft and cold foods and a diet of antibiotics and painkillers). But it was one those things that I had been delaying for over 8 months and if I hadn’t gotten it done when I did, I would have had to suffer another 8 because I just cannot get myself to visit a dentist. So if you see me at Fashion Week and I don’t smile back at you or smile really weird, you’ll know why.Moving on from my dreary dental story, I can ofcourse have all the fun I want to with my clothes. Hope you enjoy my looks that will be coming up for the next 4 days.Now onto my outfit for Day 01 that I wore today. Since Amazon Fashion is all about #IndiaModernFestive this season I decided to start with a bang and follow that style. I picked out an outfit that at first glance looks very ‘Indian’ because of the embellishments and hand-embroidery and can be worn as both a kurta and even a dress by itself (which is what I went for). The festive season is all about bling and shine which there is plenty of in my outfit but it still isn’t OTT (over the top). I keep the sparkle of the look alive with an evening clutch and a classic watch. And finish off the look with sneakers (not only because wearing sneakers with dresses is currently acceptable but also because I like to be able feel my feet as a part of my body at the end of the day). It’s all about comfort for me. My favorite part of the look is ofcourse the gold jhumkis that go so well with the entire outfit. All product links at the bottom.                                                                                                Hope you enjoyed the post! I visited their Gurgaon store in Metropolis Mall (it’s a huge store!) to explore their brand new festive collection which is quite an extensive one. They have a lot of styles that can be mixed and matched together. For example the outfit that I’m wearing is not part of a set, they are all separates that I put together and yet they look so good together. I especially loved the fit and flare of the palazzo pants that they have in numerous colors. Some dainty yet shiny accessories to complete the look and very comfortable flats. They have a lot of styles that can be mixed and matched together. For example the outfit that I’m wearing is not part of a set, they are all separates that I put together and yet they look so good together. I especially loved the fit and flare of the palazzo pants that they have in numerous colors. Some dainty yet shiny accessories to complete the look and very comfortable flats. And the combination of this pink and gold spells festive from miles away. Everything is from Max Fashion. Hope you enjoy the look!                                                                                          Happy Dussehra everyone! Hope everyone’s having a lovely holiday today. I am collaborating with Amazon and curating 5 looks that I will be…October 12, 2016In "Events"For people belonging to/working in the fashion & textile industry, fashion week is one of THE most major events of the year (twice, four times, maybe more – depending on which ones are your priority). The Amazon India Fashion Week Spring Summer ’17 is taking place from October 12th to 16th and the consecutive 5 days of back to back runway shows that never start on time, travelling to the venue and back everyday, attending after-parties, visiting designer stalls, clicking photographs, getting clicked, networking, meeting people, selling yourself or your art and perhaps managing to grab a bite somewhere in the middle, can be nothing less than a harrowing ordeal – however essential and glamorous we may project it to be. And it is of the utmost importance to be prepared for it before hand. It always helps to mark out the shows that you want to attend thanks to the schedule that gets announced and chalk out an itinerary for yourself if you’re going to be a part of the action and want to look alive while doing it. I always start out with spectacular energy when the schedule gets announced, going full steam with excitement and by the second day of fashion week I’m always mentally whispering to myself “I’m so done”. Ofcourse I still go on and power through all days making it look fabulous on my instagram account. And while I don’t want to outright whine about the fashion week (it is ofcourse one of the best ways for me to network, collaborate with brands and put myself out there and I feel extremely great that I get to be a part of it), there are a few things I always make sure I’m carrying with me during this time. I am sharing my ‘Fashion Week’ essentials that I will be carrying on me all 5 days of the Amazon India Fashion Week. Benetton can also be found on Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | Stay connected with me over Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | Pinterest | Snapchat<*client>The KYE runway show at NYFW was kinetic, fun and pop. The collection of this Seoul based label by Kathleen Kye drew heavy visual inspiration from the electric K-Pop scene. K-Pop is short for Korean pop and is a musical genre that originated in South Korea that has very characteristic audio-visual elements. Built on that, KYE had a lot of street silhouettes with bright candy colors that were punctuated with basic blacks and hints of metal accents. Definitely new-age and young. My personal favorites were the ‘HATE’ emblems on some of the pieces, the metallic maxi dress with a huge heart-shaped cut out at the back, the army jacket and the statement sunglasses that the models were wearing. A lot of energy and crisp direction in the collection as well as the show! LOVE!       The KYE runway show at NYFW was kinetic, fun and pop. In collaboration with the Taiwan Tourism Bureau, Malan presented menswear and womenswear inspired by his recent travels to Taiwan’s Sun Moon Lake. The pieces incorporated  traditional Taiwanese dying techniques, embroideries, silks, and fibers merged with modern silhouettes. It was an elaborate setup with live music.The Malan Breton show was held at the splendid Gotham Hall in New York with Style Fashion Week. In collaboration with the Taiwan Tourism Bureau, Malan presented menswear and womenswear inspired by his recent travels to Taiwan’s Sun Moon Lake. The pieces incorporated  traditional Taiwanese dying techniques, embroideries, silks, and fibers merged with modern silhouettes. It was an elaborate setup with live music.My favorite part of the show was actually the menswear. Loved a lot of the pieces and would wear them too. The element of a hoodie to the blazers was interesting but didn’t completely appeal to me. There was a silk trench coat that I wanted to steal off from the model though!The Malan Breton show was held at the splendid Gotham Hall in New York with Style Fashion Week. In collaboration with the Taiwan Tourism Bureau, Malan presented menswear and womenswear inspired by his recent travels to Taiwan’s Sun Moon Lake. The pieces incorporated  traditional Taiwanese dying techniques, embroideries, silks, and fibers merged with modern silhouettes. It was an elaborate setup with live music.My favorite part of the show was actually the menswear. Loved a lot of the pieces and would wear them too. The element of a hoodie to the blazers was interesting but didn’t completely appeal to me. There was a silk trench coat that I wanted to steal off from the model though! The pieces incorporated  traditional Taiwanese dying techniques, embroideries, silks, and fibers merged with modern silhouettes. It was an elaborate setup with live music.My favorite part of the show was actually the menswear. Loved a lot of the pieces and would wear them too. The element of a hoodie to the blazers was interesting but didn’t completely appeal to me. There was a silk trench coat that I wanted to steal off from the model though! The Spring collection was inspired by elements you see, touch and feel at your home – grommets on a chair, texture of a pillow, mesh on a kitchen wall – all these details were interpreted into clothes with impeccable finishing and attention to detail.The presentation by Tess Giberson at NYFW took you right back at home! The Spring collection was inspired by elements you see, touch and feel at your home – grommets on a chair, texture of a pillow, mesh on a kitchen wall – all these details were interpreted into clothes with impeccable finishing and attention to detail.There were pretty inserts of crochet, macrame mixed with clean & graphic materials like coated mesh and laser-cut leather. Colors were kept simple with whites, creams, blacks, indigo and just a few pieces of stripes. The collection gave me a warm fuzzy feeling even though it was for Spring – probably because it really did remind me of a cozy day at a quiet beach with the ones I love. Comfort and ease. The Ohne Titel runway show for NYFW happened today at 7:00pm at Skylight at Clarkson Square, NYC. It drizzled the whole day but luckily we didn’t have to walk too much from the subway station at Houston St. That is what the crossing at Clarkson Sq looks like.       The seating at the show was extremely efficient and thankfully very well lit. A lot of the styles were delicate and perfect for spring but had a bit of edge in them. Sheer bands across formal pants, organza trench coats, bits of lace peeking out and beautiful narrow pleats in abundance. Think of flowy chiffon silhouettes, one-shoulder knit tops and a few fabulous chain & macrame fringe dresses. You will clearly be able to point out my favorite pieces because I have shared more than one photographs of those. Still nothing compared to how late shows in Delhi start.The collection is inspired by modern decors and innovative architecture that reshaped the city of Montreal during the most successful world’s fair of the 20th century – the Expo67. There was a contrast between subtle, neutral shades and the play of solid primary colors and a small party of metallics going on as well. The metallic jackets did seem futuristic and I can imagine myself in the rose gold one with mom jeans and a plain white tee.After the show Naina & I headed to Hell’s Kitchen, a nearby restaurant. We had mussels and meatballs. A lot of dresses, outerwear and separates like culottes, midi skirts, wide pants and even a fabulous black jumpsuit that had me staring at the model for more than usual.All the pieces from this collection are definitely something that I can see myself wearing – The colors, the jackets and the silhouettes. City dressing but with a strong sense of personal style.Don’t forget to follow me Instagram and add me on Snapchat ( akanksharedhu ) for live NYFW and NYC updates! For our 1st week in NYC, Naina & I booked an apartment on the 23rd floor of a gorgeous building in the Lower East Side that gave us THE most spectacular views of the city we could have asked for. The views truly steal the ENTIRE show for this apartment, followed by how chilled out and great our host James was!       This was a 2 bedroom apartment that we shared with the host James and he was so helpful with recommending nearby places to check out, eat at, how to go about getting to places. It’s ironic that towards the end of our stay at his place, he left for Chennai for a friend’s wedding! That’s Naina & I with James on a sunny Saturday afternoon up on the roof terrace of the building.       The Lower East Side is such a vibrant neighbourhood! Between planning and organizing our calendar during NYFW, trying out new places to eat at, meeting up with friends and making new ones in the city, our 7 days sped by faster than you can type out #RedhuxNYC on your cellphone! Here is just a glimpse of our time at our first Airbnb place in New York City. Some places to eat that you should definitely eat once if you’re in the neighbourhood:The Cake Shop – A great selection of beers and vegan desserts.                  Mezetto – Do not miss their salads. Absolutely perfect!                  Sugar Cafe – Open 24/7, a typical american deli with sandwiches, good coffee and seating right on the sidewalk. It’s a perfect place if you want to spend your day watching people walk by.                         We ate a staple brekkie of eggs, bananas, some more fruit, almonds & green tea that we all shopped from the close-by Whole Foods thanks to James’ tips. James also has some wicked music set-up in his apartment.        Experiencing a new city or place through Airbnb is so different and sometimes even better than a hotel stay in my opinion. Firstly, the rents for a prime area are so much more affordable through Airbnb, you get free-wifi and the most important aspect is the social one. We got to interact with so many people including James and get a real feel of what life would probably be like if we were to live in NYC. I feel that you get better exposed to the local cultures and even end up making friends. On the other hand, the maximum interaction I have ever had while putting up in a hotel is when I’ve needed room-service or my key-card has stopped working which is truly dull. If you want to experience real living n a city, going grocery shopping, sun soaking on the roof terrace with the locals, finding the hidden gem of a coffee shop/ bar that won’t be listed in any books or websites, Airbnb is for you.What a splendid first week we have had on our NYC trip this September! Our first week in NYC ( Naina & I ) and we can’t get enough of this city! We have a bunch of NYFW shows that we will be attending and a few other meetings and other than that the city is all ours! We did our very first shoots on Ludlow Street on which our 1st Airbnb apartment is located. The historic Katz’s Delicatssen is located at the very beginning of Ludlow Street on the Lower East Side and when you walk in further there’s an array of some gorgeous stores both fashion & organic beauty that can occupy your whole day! Our apartment is located on the 23rd floor that has gifted us the most SPECTACULAR views of New York City, They are unbelievable! #RedhuxNYC That’s the Empire State Building lit up for #LaborDay.             Here is what I wore on just one of our days out on Ludlow Street out and about on the Lower East Side. All red. Kinda like red-riding-hood lost in the wrong forest. #justkidding Some of the must-visit stores on Ludlow are Assembly New York, The Reformation, ODD NYC, Marmalade Vintage and The Cake Shop. The cake shop has a fabulous selection of beers and fabulous vegan desserts, especially cupcakes. Vintage stores are absolute treasures too!       Our first week in NYC ( Naina & I ) and we can’t get enough of this city! We have a bunch of NYFW shows that we will be attending and a few other meetings and other than that the city is all ours! We did our very first shoots on Ludlow Street on which our 1st Airbnb apartment is located. The historic Katz’s Delicatssen is located at the very beginning of Ludlow Street on the Lower East Side and when you walk in further there’s an array of some gorgeous stores both fashion & organic beauty that can occupy your whole day! Our apartment is located on the 23rd floor that has gifted us the most SPECTACULAR views of New York City, They are unbelievable! #RedhuxNYC That’s the Empire State Building lit up for #LaborDay. With the folks and Naina. A much MUCH needed break from all the madness before leaving for New York. We stayed in the cantonment which is super close to the local Kasauli market. Data network was a total bitch so it turned into a kind of a forced vacation for me. Limited only to communication through email and instagram updates which were a struggle on their own. So all I was left to do was click pictures from the camera, eat food and take walks in the heavy mist and empty roads.       This was my first ever trip to Kasauli. With the folks and Naina. The Army Mess where we had a lot of our meals      This was my first ever trip to Kasauli. With the folks and Naina. A much MUCH needed break from all the madness before leaving for New York. We stayed in the cantonment which is super close to the local Kasauli market. Data network was a total bitch so it turned into a kind of a forced vacation for me. Limited only to communication through email and instagram updates which were a struggle on their own. So all I was left to do was click pictures from the camera, eat food and take walks in the heavy mist and empty roads.       We all unanimously fell in love with the Kasauli Club – very well maintained and a gorgeous setting. The food was on point and Naina & I went nuts taking photographs. I have also shared my outfit in this post which was our first visit to the Kasauli Club.       In real time I am all packed for my month in September with Naina. We have about 7 shows / presentations that we have RSVP’d to during NYFW, a few other meetings with brands and designers and I can’t tell between the excitement and the stress anymore. Boarding the flight tonight. For good reason too! It looks so good, put together and yet just a little bit rough – just like Maverick. #justkiddingI remember doing an outfit with denim on denim in August around 3 years back HERE. And I cannot believe how far I’ve come, how far this blog has come – right from the quality of my pictures, to my poses, to the type of text I used to write – it has all changed a lot, for the better I think. And I’m so happy I continued to do this. I love it!Back to my outfit, The new collection at VERO MODA has a lot of new age pieces, edgy and almost reminding you of the normcore craze a while back. I picked out this denim on denim look which has an element of rebel as well as a certain sharpness to it at the same time. A rebellious-chic if you may – ‘Maverick’. I have down-played the fringes and kept them a bit hidden with the denim dress that I have actually worn as an outer-layer. And those jeans are so smart!                                                                                     Hope you enjoyed this post! Regular practice keeps the spine strong and flexible. This asana instantly calms the mind and helps in reducing stress and fatigue. Definitely relieves tension in the neck and back. It also improves digestion and eases symptoms of headache and sinusitis.How To Do It:~  Stand straight. While exhaling bend forward from your hips rather than the waist. ~  Slightly suck your tummy in while bending further and focus on lengthening the torso. ~  Knees should be kept straight and not bent. ~  You can place your fingertips or your palms on the floor beside your feet, or hold your big toes or hold the back of your ankles. ~  Try and point your buttocks to the sky, keep lengthening your torso and let your head, neck and shoulders be completely loose and free. ~  Stay in this posture for 30 seconds to a minute. ~  For coming back up, take the support of your hands on your hips, inhale and come up with a long front torso rather than rolling your spine back up.The Uttanasana or ‘Standing Forward Bend Pose’ is another great way to get a quick stretch at any time of the day for me. It’s not something you would go for right away but it makes the entire outfit so much more ‘hip’. No? It was fun though.I stopped making New Year Resolutions many years back because you can do that any day of the year. But I do, always, make a little list where I write down the things I will have in the next year – as a mental declaration to myself (so that I subconsciously work towards it). And I think it’s important to focus on the things you will want to have, not the things that you want to avoid – give weightage to the positives, not the negatives. It’s a mental image of where I’d like to be in the New Year and it more or less works for me, I obviously don’t go around writing ‘Aston Martins’ in my list because that shit holds no importance to me – UBER is just fine thank you! It’s so frustrating when I see articles and lists of ‘rules’ that you need to be aware of in fashion. Wear this, don’t wear that. It’s so subjective, what I like, the second person may completely despise for their own reasons – heck my own mother finds my middle hair parting repulsive. But that didn’t stop me from keeping a middle parting ALL THE TIME for a year straight! When it comes to fashion, I have always been vocal about not being very fond of trends or never being interested in following them – and I still stick to it – why must one take fashion so seriously – they’re clothes and outfits and you only need to be comfortable and have fun with it. It’s so frustrating when I see articles and lists of ‘rules’ that you need to be aware of in fashion. Wear this, don’t wear that. It’s so subjective, what I like, the second person may completely despise for their own reasons – heck my own mother finds my middle hair parting repulsive. But that didn’t stop me from keeping a middle parting ALL THE TIME for a year straight! I always got nagged for it – but I loved how different it made me look (and I also got a LOT of support and love from a lot of you guys! So it kept me going heh). Which is why this post (and outfit) is just my way of reiterating that in fashion ‘rules don’t apply’. Wear whatever you want as long as you know it makes you feel good. And just the right amount of ‘grand’ in those earrings that adds a festive hint to the outfit. I could even wear this as a Christmas outfit myself.Hope you enjoy the post and the pics! We stayed at the JW Marriott Mussoorie and were blessed with beautiful sunny days through most of our stay. I think this is the first time I have worn an outfit pairing checks and stripes together. I wasn’t entirely sure of whether it would look alright but decided to go for it anyway. After I tried them on I definitely thought that it worked really well together so I decided to stick with it.Even though I’m more of a beach girl, I never say no to a trip to the hills because I love them too! The crisp sunlight, blue skies and the fragrance of forest and pine drifting everywhere causes instant de-stressing. It is shameful how horribly crowded “hill-stations” in India are now unfortunately. With horse-shit everywhere on the roads and people pissing right beside it on street-sides. Which is why main towns are always avoided. And there are still some beautiful, secluded areas around if you make the effort of looking for them.As I type this text, I’m simultaneously making mental lists of what all remains to be packed for my upcoming trip. I’m super excited because it’s a long one this time. 50 days. I start off with an official trip with Indonesian Tourism for 10 days. After that I head to London for another 10 days that also includes 3 days in Edinburgh. And finally I fly to San Francisco where I spend 30 days in California (10 in SF followed by road trip via a few national forests to La. 4-5 days in LA and then fly back to India)I’m carrying some beautiful outfits by independent Indian designers that I would love to introduce you to so look out for my updates #RedhuxIndieDesign. Meanwhile enjoy this look!                                                Hope you enjoyed the post! LUISAVIAROMA is an Italian website that offers collections from 600 established designers as well as young emerging talents and is originally based out of Florence. And the best part about shopping from LUISAVIAROMA is that firstly shipping to India is now FREE and secondly the pricing you see on their website for any product is inclusive of all import fees and duty. It gives you a crystal clear idea of exactly how much you will be spending when buying that Dolce & Gabbana Bag for yourself. No hidden or extra charges to be paid anywhere after. Now that I’ve introduced you to Luisaviaroma, let me share my lust-list of blue bags with you! Which one’s your favorite? Bringing together labels ‘Rose’ by Karishma Dhingra, La Vie Boheme by Vero M and SO Jewelry to create this perfect-for-Greece outfit. Details at the end of the post as always.Get ready for a beautiful summer day of shopping ladies and discover & support Indian designers from across the country on the 12th at Fashion Capsule! Specially curated by Executive Chef Neeraj Tyagi, who is under training by Michelin Star Chef Florent Boivin from the institute of Paul Bocuse in Lyon, this menu features options that will delight your palate and keep you feeling light and healthy.  I recently visited the restaurant Sorrento at Shangri-La’s Eros Hotel in New Delhi to experience their new healthy Italian ‘Au Naturel’ menu which was exceptionally refreshing and light. Specially curated by Executive Chef Neeraj Tyagi, who is under training by Michelin Star Chef Florent Boivin from the institute of Paul Bocuse in Lyon, this menu features options that will delight your palate and keep you feeling light and healthy.  Straying from the typical healthy salads and stir-fried dishes, the menu has been infused with a touch of decadence, which is evident in gourmet dishes such as the Atlantic crab salad, poached lobster, summer vegetable salad and potato ravioli, as well as others. It was a beautiful lunch with perfect Delhi weather for a change. The screen is a 5.2″ full-HD screen that has a vibrant display and makes all photos pop!              Here is what this particular photograph turned out to be like.             Some more photographs I clicked using the Nubia Z11 miniS       I like how it performs in settings of high-contrast as well. It has captured the bright outdoors as well as it has captured places under the shade.                   Colors are also captured with a really good balance.                         Look at how well it has captured the flying birds at Suryagarh!                         An impressive battery life and a multi-functional fingerprint recognition which makes me feel super high-tech. I mostly took a lot of photographs and a few videos using the device and I needed to charge it only once during my 8 day road-trip. Granted I did not use it for surfing the web or doing heavy stuff like watching youtube videos, the battery performed really well.            A snappy new smartphone – The Nubia Z11 miniS has launched in India today and I can finally share my experience with the device – I had carried it with me to my recent road-trip in Rajasthan, discovering Jaisalmer & Bikaner and have only been able to share sneak peeks until now! Today I can show you all the amazing photographs I took using this feature-packed smartphone while I used it as a replacement for my usual DLSR – heck I even did a quick outfit shoot with the device and it came out great! Great enough to share right here on the blog!You can purchase the phone exclusively on Amazon India (in stock on March 23rd but can be ordered now!). Click here to go to the shoppable link.A quick introduction to the Nubia Z11 miniS and my favorite features of the smartphone: The body is 158 gms and comes in two colors – khaki grey & moon gold. I went for the khaki grey and it compliments any outfit.             It clicks beautiful selfies with an impressive depth of field so your face doesn’t end up looking like a pasty flat surface. Does rather well in low light as well. The best selfies are, in my opinion, clicked in direct sunlight. But this one was clicked in the shade and looks smashing. The selfie camera is an impressive 13-megapixel one, built with the SONY IMX258 Exmor RS sensor.       This selfie has been clicked in direct sunlight with no makeup on so the camera does a good job of smoothing the skin out smartly.       Takes clear photographs with really clear details. That is because of the 23MP rear camera with 6P Sapphire lens and F2.0 aperture which helps capture sharper details even in low light. It also has a rapid focus of 0.1 seconds! During lunch at Suryagarh, I took this photograph of my glass of beer. The focus is on the glass which is why the background appears a bit blurred. The 2nd photograph is merely a zoom in of the same photograph showing you exactly how impressive the details come out. You can even spot the tiny bubbles clearly.             Beauty Camera that allows you to play with your photographs and editing which is perfect if you’re a blogger like me and need your content to be just perfect. A lot of fun things to play around with like multiple exposure, slow shutter, star trail, trajectory, clone, a macro camera, panorama and lots more. Here are some pics I got clicked of my outfit at Narendra Bhawan using the device. A fun little project which was so much more interesting than simply shooting an outfit I’d say. What do you think?! Enjoy these pics of Rajasthan and how I decided to #ShowYourVogue! The wide selection includes Benarasi from Uttar Pradesh, Chikankari from Lucknow, Kalamkari from Andhra Pradesh, Maheshwari from Madhya Pradesh, Handblock Print from Rajasthan, Bandhani from Gujarat along with eclectic crafts like Patola, Madhubani, Kantha, Chanderi in clothing, Terracotta & Meenakari in jewellery, Kutchi bags, Dhurries & Dhokra in home & kitchen categories sourced directly from large organized brands like Jaypore, Indusdiva, Fabindia, Unnati Silks and brands like Craftisan, Kilol, Caravan and more.I put together this beautiful outfit from the Handloom Store and I think it’s going to be my favorite look from all 4 days. Instant love for this ‘Dabu’ printed dress by Jaypore. It is a blend of silk & cotton and made from hand block printed textile. Dabu is a ‘mud resist’ block printing technique in which a thick viscous paste made of clay, lime, tree gum and insect eaten wheat is used in a printing process to resist the desired pattern from dyeing colors. native to rajasthan, dabu printing is now practiced in just a few clusters like the village of akola. A light breezy dress with summery layers paired with a silk wool handloom stole (also by Jaypore) in a brilliant green (this color is already sold out but you can find different colors as well). There, I said it.– Music festivals are probably the only place where you don’t totally hate humans in general coz somehow no-one seems to want to behave like a complete asshole. – There are 2 kinds of people – those who think that the bindis on your chin are a band-aid(mostly men) and those who’ll ask you if you have any more coz it looks bomb(mostly women)– Alcohol has been a pretty amazing pal but you’re growing older now & more & more incapable of handling it and that’s somehow totally okay because you couldn’t give two fucks about it. Also, if you try n fight it you make a pretty memorable mockery of yourself. Cheers!– That I just may be a whiskey kinda gal (after beer ofcourse) – that’s mostly because of the sheer volume of whiskey Jameson made you consume in the span of 4 days (more than what I’ve consumed in all my life combined until now)– That any kind of food is just so damn good and you eat it because you are lucky enough to have access to it while you spend majority of 4 days being hungover, hungry forever (maybe that’s how the term was coined?)Cheers you! Sunny days are a solace and my only window to look like I actually put some thought into my outfit instead of my standard 2 layers of warm inners covered with whatever since that’s anyway going to get covered further with my biggest fluffiest down feather jacket, so why bother.I also have never been a fan of spending too much time on deciding what I should wear so I form a mini collection of permutations and combinations that spend a larger part of my winters in. I’m showing you a few of my winter essentials in today’s outfit – each piece a versatile piece on it’s own that can be worn with lots of other things.The Long Grey Pullover I love it mostly because of the grey color and the texture it has. It definitely doesn’t do anything to keep you warm since it’s cotton so I absolutely have an inner under that.Blue Denim Jeans The thicker the fabric the better (warmer it will keep you). But I have started liking the stretchy ones more than the rugged ones because the latter just seems too suffocating now.A Large Leather Bag I’m not entirely sure why but my space requirements in a carry bag/purse increase significantly in the colder months as compared to the summers. This genuine leather Phive Rivers bag in a ‘Midnight Blue’ color fits everything I could possibly want to carry on my person and then some. Love the croc print on it and the fact that is it handcrafted by 5 artisans! The brand also comes out with new styles every 30-40 days!Black Booties Classics again.Quirky Sunglasses In your dreary, colorless winter outfit it should be made mandatory to have one element/accessory that stands out and makes you seem less dead inside. I picked these retro heart shaped sunglasses from Café des Arts in Pondicherry during my recent New Year’s trip. You can read more about the Cafe here. And just for ₹ 800/-Brown Lipstick I’m a recent convert to lipsticks with brown tones in them (I think KimK is to blame). I always felt that brown and dull tones make me look older (and maybe they even do) as compared to vibrant reds or pinks that have always been my favorites). But all that has changed now. Where’s the fun if you don’t experiment right?! You can see all my Pinterest madness here.I decided to bring together my favorite Pinterest elements and home decor ideas together for you to kick start the new year with some fresh inspiration. Small changes can make a huge difference in the way your home looks and these do just that. Have a look:If you are not too confident of having such a huge plant you can opt for smaller potted ones with huge leaves for a similar effect. Love this idea of putting the plant on a tiny stool to add more height and character.       A matte grey pot for green plants looks really good too.       I also love the idea of breaking your white walls with intermittent creeper plants in the room. Don’t these look cute? I love plain white walls too but this adds more interest visually.       Copper or metallic pots are another rage. Not only are metallics in trend everywhere else like fashion and beauty but using just one metallic element like this within the green and white elements in the room looks so darn good!       This obviously won’t last very long but looks equally good and classy and is an ideal way to spruce up your living room if you have guests coming over – put a big leaf in water in a smooth big glass bowl. Chic and clean.       If you, like me lack a green thumb, cacti are your saviours (very good looking ones might I add). Plus they help make all your flatlay shoots look so good. I had named my little cactus Bubsters but he recently died while I was away for New Year. I think it was because I left him under direct sunlight and forgot him there. Sorry Bubsters! I miss you!       However, if you can’t even take care of cacti, there is still hope for you. Like these cacti candles. Whaaaaa! These look so good! Imagine them lit up with low lighting in the room for an evening. Classy!       I’m crazy about anything cactus right now so this wallpaper look super fine too! Love the boring black and white where the cactus gives it a completely fun feel.       Talking about wallpapers, polka dots give a retro, fun and smart look too. Tip – all the dots shouldn’t be the same size, have them of different sizes to add some mystery and interest.       Or perhaps have watercolor paint on your wall for a mystic feel? I’m not sure whether you can DIY this successfully but you sure can try. Looks so nautical and moody!       While I know you don’t really need fireplaces in a shitty place like Delhi, I didn’t want to limit myself. Just look at this! Don’t you want to be sitting in that chair RIGHT NOW!       Neon signs may not give off the classiest vibes but who cares, you like it, you take it. And I love it! I probably would switch it off when I go to sleep but I’d love to have it on all during the day. Haah! I instantly fell in love with the maxi wrap dress (for some strange reason you don’t find this silhouette at many places and it is such a flattering piece of clothing for so many body types, it should literally be a staple in all wardrobes). So, I was sold when I saw this cross n knots printed wrap-maxi-dress. It’s made out of a lovely soft knit fabric that sticks to the right curves and falls off so effortlessly from the others. I decided to play with some layering since the maxi is a sleeveless one and added a flimsy longline shrug to it with a contrasting micro print. To some, they may look like an odd pair but to me they perfectly balance off each other. The delicate and light fabric flies off easily against the heavier fabric of the maxi dress. The maxi dress does have a hook higher up on the neckline for ladies who want to cover up the neckline, but you know me, I’m loving my tanned non-ample bosom post my recent Thai trip and a deep neckline is anyway so damn sexy! The Cuore watch has been created by Salvatore Ferragamo as a perfect accessory and an ideal gift of love for a special occasion like an anniversary or even the birthday of a loved one. And what sets it apart is the steel heart inside the dial which “beats” once a second as its two halves separate and then reunite, driven by a patented device. The secret is an innovative quartz movement, designed and manufactured exclusively for Salvatore Ferragamo. Pressing the crown starts the function, while the time is set with a button at 2 o’clock using a special heart-shaped tool. It truly is a special and mesmerising object and I have managed to fascinate everybody I know closely with my Cuore Ferragamo and it’s beating heart. I’m in LOVE!
