It makes me incredibly proud to be able to contribute to raising public awareness of the situation that individuals with autism face. I believe that these individuals will greatly benefit from the possibility of learning to communicate, of receiving academic training and of developing real social relationships.”Here are some pics from her visit to Saint-Imier.                                          All photographs courtesy LonginesLongines can also be found on Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | Pinterest | Stay connected with me over Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | Pinterest | SnapchatOne of my favorite Swiss watchmakers, Longines has recently welcomed Kate Winslet, it’s Ambassador of Elegance to Saint-Imier in Switzerland, where the brand was first created in 1832. Kate, accompanied by Walter von Känel, President of Longines witnessed the production and assembly processes. She also visited the Longines Museum, where she fell in love with a particular watch from the Flagship Collection which the brand has now decided to re-issue during the course of the year. Proceeds of the sales of this watch will go towards the Golden Hat Foundation – a non-profit organization co-founded by Kate Winslet in 2010. The Golden Hat Foundation strives to highlight the capabilities and the immense potential of individuals with autism.For the past 6 years, Kate Winslet has been Longines‘ Ambassador of Elegance and Longines’ deeply held values are fully in line with those demonstrated by the actress through the Golden Hat Foundation. The Swiss watchmaker is thrilled to be associated with such a shining example of altruism as Kate Winslet since it has a long tradition of supporting worthy causes. What a lovely, symbiotic and elegant relationship!At the end of this eventful day, Kate was eager to meet with Longines employees, who had gathered for the occasion. The actress took the opportunity to say a few words: “I was delighted to learn that Longines is so in touch with its rich history, from which it draws inspiration for creating new works of art that adhere to its values. I am deeply grateful to Longines for the support they have shown for the Golden Hat Foundation, an organization that is dear to my heart, by re-issuing the watch that I have chosen today. It makes me incredibly proud to be able to contribute to raising public awareness of the situation that individuals with autism face. I believe that these individuals will greatly benefit from the possibility of learning to communicate, of receiving academic training and of developing real social relationships.”Here are some pics from her visit to Saint-Imier. Matching pant-suits are so hot right now, especially where the jacket is not very form fitting but rather a bit loose and airy – it’s both comfortable and chic. And the perfect place for me to buy jewellery that will take me from hard-core work vibes to social evenings is Melorra. They have such an extensive list of options categorized according to occasion & even trends and you will find so many sleek, subtle and beautiful pieces that will be appropriate for both work and fun so you don’t have to stress over changing your look. More importantly their pricing is so competitive that you almost always end up with more that what you had wanted in your shopping-cart. I recently visited the huge Wills Lifestyle Store in South-Extension, New Delhi for a preview of their fresh new Spring Summer 2016 collection and FRESH it was! I was pleasantly surprised by the variety of styles the brand has introduced this time which no longer restricts it to the work-wear image that most people associate Wills Lifestyle with. And I’m all for it – mostly because I’m not bound by any workplace codes to wear formals etc. I can have fun with my looks even when I’m heading to a work meeting and some pieces from the SS16 collection by Wills Lifestyle allow you to do just that – have fun with your workwear too. For example they have lovely polo-tees that you can wear with a formal pair of trousers, the catch being that the polo-tees have fresh prints like spectacles or cactii on them! There are lots of soft pastels, delicate florals and even peplum tops! You also have the option of jumpsuits with bold prints and summery maxi dresses – there is something for everyone. The Menswear is not to be left behind either – my favorite was a navy blue shirt with a pink flamingo printed all over it – love at first sight!I also got to style 2 models with my favorite looks from the new collection and that was a fun activity which was followed by luscious little cupcakes with ‘Wills Lifestyle’ printed on them! A great, casual day of fun activities and discovering a brand new take on the Wills Lifestyle personality. Here are some pics from my time at the store and some of my favorite styles from the Spring Summer Collection. Hope you enjoy!            Super cute – nerdy print.       Really like this dress because it will take you straight from work to cocktails with your girlfriends in the evening. The Moto X Style won my heart with the crisp pictures it clicked and the spectacular display screen it has. It is also very useful when you are travelling because it has a dual sim feature. Plus you can connect the watch to your Google Fit account to keep everything backed up. Another feature I really like is ofcourse Google Keep with which you can see all your to-do lists on the watch. I also love to play around with the display of the watch – there are so many options that you can download from Google Playstore. I’m using the ‘Mysterious Forest’ watchface here. The Moto X Style won my heart with the crisp pictures it clicked and the spectacular display screen it has. It is also very useful when you are travelling because it has a dual sim feature. The cellphone also has a water-repellent coating protecting it from the inside out so it’s great when you’ve just taken a dip on the beach and want to take a quick selfie with your wet hands. It was an easy and comfortable afternoon at Lodi – The Garden Restaurant where I got to meet the zestful Canon India team, a few bloggers and we even got a quick masterclass in food photography by Arjun and Praerna Kartha who are a husband and wife duo of photographer (Arjun) & food stylist (Praerna)After a short & crisp introduction to the camera by Mr. Andrew Koh, the Vice President of Consumer Imaging & Information Centre for Canon India, everybody got to play around with the Canon EOS 1300D and my favorite feature HAD to be the Wi-Fi/NFC because well, being a blogger there is nothing more I like than getting DSLR quality pics sent to my cellphone immediately where I can do a quick edit in VSCO cam and upload them on my insta profile or twitter or even my blog right there and then. After having met their lovely team, I go to style my very own model, Eva in my favorite pieces from their Spring Summer collection, take loads of selfies and pics and I also got to meet and hang with a few lovely people from the blogger fam – Srish & Aman from Style Fashion Etc, Riya from Caught in a Cuff, Dolly from Spill the Sass, Shalini from Be Beautilicious and Deeptima from Beauty Unleashed. The other bloggers went about styling their own looks as well. I was recently invited by Oxolloxo to celebrate their 2nd Anniversary at a blogger’s meet at Summerhouse Cafe and also get a first hand look at their Spring Summer 16 collection. What a blast that day was! After having met their lovely team, I go to style my very own model, Eva in my favorite pieces from their Spring Summer collection, take loads of selfies and pics and I also got to meet and hang with a few lovely people from the blogger fam – Srish & Aman from Style Fashion Etc, Riya from Caught in a Cuff, Dolly from Spill the Sass, Shalini from Be Beautilicious and Deeptima from Beauty Unleashed. The other bloggers went about styling their own looks as well. The Spring Summer 16 collection by Oxolloxo is the epitome of summer! Pretty prints, lots of off-shoulders, pastel yellows, blues, skater skirts, printed cotton pants, light denims and layers. They also had some really fun accessories. My absolute favorite was a headband with a huge red velvet bow on it. I styled my first look with it. The whole day was spent in catching up, discovering the collection, styling the models, taking photographs, eating tid-bits, taking crazy boomerang videos and just getting to know everyone. I really do love events like these where there aren’t too many poeple that you don’t end up remembering anyone at all – instead there is a controlled number of people and you get to interact with everyone and spend some good quality time doing constructive activities. An absolutely lovely 2nd anniversary celebrations with Oxolloxo. It’s such a lovely, light-weight and airy dress, not to mention it’s also a shirt-dress so it can even be worn open from the front over your bikini if you’re somewhere on a beach or even a white cami and denims. I have picked out the most romantic floral print blouse and styled it in a 100% office/ formal look all from VERO MODA and it works so well. The sharp silhouette of the blazer with the sleek fall of the trousers coincide so well with the softness of the floral blouse. The outfit brings together the best of both worlds – cold hard business but with the softness that shows you care (I’d imagine). A dame meaning business (come to think of it, that’s what the name for this post should have been)What do you think of this look? It’s about 30-40 minutes on a two-wheeler from where we are currently living in Bangrak, Koh Samui. When you know you will have to spend that kind of time on a bike under direct sunlight, you best cover yourself up. I learnt that the hard way and literally got my skin roasted that day. And once you’re burnt, it’s just pointless trying to get that even, sexy tan you had been dreaming about since you planned the trip. Boo! Nonetheless, Coconut Beach is on the West coast of Koh Samui so it is absolutely the PERFECT place if you want to catch a sunset. We unfortunately had to leave after lunch that day. It’s right next to the pier and has a LOT of shallow water and white sand. Tourists keep coming in bunches but it’s never too crowded and can make for a great photo-op. I wore a fresh outfit that gave a great vibrant contrast to the blues. Continuing with my “Koh Samui’ series, here is another one when we spent the day at Coconut Beach. It’s about 30-40 minutes on a two-wheeler from where we are currently living in Bangrak, Koh Samui. When you know you will have to spend that kind of time on a bike under direct sunlight, you best cover yourself up. I learnt that the hard way and literally got my skin roasted that day. And once you’re burnt, it’s just pointless trying to get that even, sexy tan you had been dreaming about since you planned the trip. Boo! Koh Samui is surprisingly not as hot and humid as I imagined it would be in early March (phew!). If you are stationery under the sun yes you will get hot and burnt but if you’re moving on the bike it’s pretty nice. Pleasant in the evenings too.Shirt dresses are your best bet when travelling to tropical regions. During NYFW Naina & I had come for a show at Skylight Clarkson Sq and the Hudson River Greenway which runs all along the Hudson riverfront was just next door so we decided to walk around, explore and soak in a sunset which was SO worth it. The golden light was deliciously perfect and there were so many people out for their evening runs and walks. We sat around to watch the sun set completely and then moved on. While I have technically never really been on a date (nerd alert), I have more often than not imagined what a first date would be like. And I have imagined what I would wear for the occasion as well. Even though I may have a hidden tomboy in some nook & cranny of my heart, I do love my jewellery and I do love my dresses from time to time – especially when it’s to get ready for date night. While I have technically never really been on a date (nerd alert), I have more often than not imagined what a first date would be like. And I have imagined what I would wear for the occasion as well. I usually first decide what accessories or jewellery I’d like to go for and decide my outfit around that. And I have recently found a really great jewellery app by Melorra that is excitingly very inspiring. While you can do the usual stuff like browse through their catalog and shop the jewellery you like, the best part about the app is their editorials – each and every piece of jewellery has been styled impeccably, worn by real models and categorized based on occasion or collection. The app is literally a magazine for jewellery. Real, certified jewellery you can put to very good use regardless of the time and age. I’m not really a fan of macarons so it was like whatever frankly (ladies don’t be aghast – it’s me not you) and then we also ordered a really good looking dessert but that wasn’t quite upto my expectations either (then again, I like my desserts chocolatey and heavy and this was deceptively light I suppose or maybe it’s just French desserts, I’m not quite sure). But loved the interiors, the atmosphere, the coffee and the salad so it was definitely a win! Yay! Miss that month in NYC so so bad! It’s already been a whole fashion season already. Uggh! We also stopped by and checked out the Anthropologie store nearby. It looked like a much bigger and posher version of Sarojini Nagar for some reason. Oh man it's been so long now almost feels like it didn't happen - the New York trip! Soho is bustling with activity - tourists, shoppers and people who work around that area. A lot of high-end and luxury brands…On a particularly sunny day Naina & I were walking around in Soho and just chanced upon Ladurée and we knew we HAD to eat there (we were ofcourse starving too!). Walking is just the best way to explore Manhattan – that and yes a month’s subway pass. I think this was a weekday if I’m not wrong and we went in during lunch time. The outdoor seating of the restaurant was bustling but indoors was very quiet and it was only us seated indoors. Really pretty interiors. Ordered some salad. Gobbled that up. Loved it. Then just because it was Ladurée we tried out the French macarons. I’m not really a fan of macarons so it was like whatever frankly (ladies don’t be aghast – it’s me not you) and then we also ordered a really good looking dessert but that wasn’t quite upto my expectations either (then again, I like my desserts chocolatey and heavy and this was deceptively light I suppose or maybe it’s just French desserts, I’m not quite sure). But loved the interiors, the atmosphere, the coffee and the salad so it was definitely a win! Yay! Miss that month in NYC so so bad! It’s already been a whole fashion season already. Uggh! We also stopped by and checked out the Anthropologie store nearby. It looked like a much bigger and posher version of Sarojini Nagar for some reason.                                                                                                The Anthropologie store                   And then heading back home.             See lots more of New York on my Blog. It is inspired by the brilliant hues of the sea, sea creatures and over-all is just such a fanciful collection. Some of the pieces are absolutely stunning pieces of art an I already have my eye of some that I would desperately love to wear during my trip to Thailand in March – on the beach!!!But today I’m showing you a few of my favorites from this new Swarovski  collection. I have layered a few rings together to balance out the wonderful statement necklace, kept the earrings simple and added a fabulous watch to finish the look. While the colors and crystals of the statement necklace  may seem overwhelming to some, it is the exact same reason I’m in love with it and thought of showing you how you can wear it with a smart evening look even during the day and carry it forward for the night. There is nothing as special as a deep neckline to show off a necklace that deserves it’s own audience and the hot pink just seemed to compliment the accessories . What do you think of the look? In-fact their usp happens to be the variety of sizes that they offer for the best possible fit – 18 different sizes to be precise. Happy days are here! At first glance the sizing may seem a bit complicated but it’s literally just 2 minutes of understanding the chart.Work-wear can mean VERY different things to different people and you can’t really box it in with a specific definition any more. Which is why I decided to give a little spin to my idea of work-wear. If you look at the pieces of clothing separately it sounds exactly formal – a shirt with a bow + trousers + long jacket. But when you place them all together it gives you quite a different look. Totally digging the vibe of this outfit I picked out from KAARYAH. I’d love to know what you think of the outfit and whether you would wear something like this to work? Eventually my search led to me to a really simple but fantastic website – Stage3 – where I could rent fabulous designer outfits for literally a fraction of their actual costs. The BEST part about the website happens to be the curation of the outfits they have on offer. There have been a few sites that have been around working on a similar model but Stage3 has lovely taste. No matter what outfit you pick to rent and wear, it will be special, stylish, great looking and ofcourse ‘designer’. The rest of the model is quite simple – you just head on to the site and everything is self-explanatory.So I quickly selected a brilliantly on-point outfit – a Sabyasachi Mukherjee ensemble – a luscious red bandhgala type full length embroidered jacket in silk. Under this I wore my own black cami and wide pants and it looked so good! No Indianwear drama and I was comfy and looking sharp the whole day – the wedding and reception were combined so it was a long day mind you. I paired the look with some vintage Kashmiri jewelry that I took from my mom and a Ritu Kumar clutch and simple black heels. What do you think of this look? The jacket could have just as easily been worn with a skirt as well I think. It does have a certain aura about it – workwear. Makes you take your work just a tad bit more seriously and that can sometimes be a very good thing. As much as I like wearing structured blazers, I somehow don’t feel comfortable in them when I know I have to wear them all day. It limits your shoulder movement and I find that very frustrating – you can’t even lift your arms completely. So I tend to wear blazers when it’s just a meeting. But when I know I have to spend my entire day in the outfit, I look for more comfortable options – enter this perfect substitute – the slinky trench. It’s flowy and  doesn’t limit your arm movement and looks just as formal and serious as any other workwear. The easiest option to go for in workwear is solids. You generally tend to not have too much time to think about your formal outfit so the best way is to keep it simple and not get confused by prints and patterns. I paired my tan trench with a solid blue top and black palazzos. Simple, non-fussy, comfortable and work-wearable. There isn’t much to my outfit – just a simple over-sized white shirt with a basic black skirt, with even more basic but comfy shoes and a statement necklace to balance out all the basic-ness I suppose. Looking at this outfit I almost fantasize about being a New Yorker myself haahah! But what’s gotten me more excited now is my upcoming trips – one short one with Naina and our boys to Mussoorie (we are being hosted by JW Marriott, Mussoorie) and then the longer trip I’m doing with Aman – 11 nights in Koh Samui and 2-3 nights in Bangkok. That one should be a good break. I am ofcouse mixing it with work because I don’t think I can stay away from work for so long! So you’ll see me wearing a lot of fun looks/ accessories and things. 11 days of being on a beach, soaking some sun, getting that tan back, feet in the sand and salty hair. I’m absolutely in love with my life as a blogger and the rewards I get out of it. But I am working pretty much 24/7 now – it’s constantly on – social media, clicking pictures, editing, attending events, doing shoots, travelling, drafting blog posts, replying to emails, taking phone calls and then some. I never get a day off – 24 hours of having absolutely nothing to do. And sometimes I miss that. It reminds me of the times when I was unemployed where I would spend hours online listening to music, discovering new music and adding new music to my library. I don’t get to do that anymore and that’s no fun because listening to new music was one of my most favorite things in the world. You find that one song that you really like and play it on loop for a week. Music is always on in the background all day – that just doesn’t seem to happen anymore and I feel that it does have an effect on my mood too. Maybe there is a way I can dedicate a day in the month to just doing this – finding new music, listening to music all day and literally re-introduce music in my life. I’d like that. It reminds me of the times when I was unemployed where I would spend hours online listening to music, discovering new music and adding new music to my library. I don’t get to do that anymore and that’s no fun because listening to new music was one of my most favorite things in the world. You find that one song that you really like and play it on loop for a week. Music is always on in the background all day – that just doesn’t seem to happen anymore and I feel that it does have an effect on my mood too. Maybe there is a way I can dedicate a day in the month to just doing this – finding new music, listening to music all day and literally re-introduce music in my life. I’d like that. It’s been forever since I’ve added new music in my iPod and I’d really really like to add some, take it with me to the park with some really good headphones and spend the day just listening to it – nothing else.And while I’m at it, I wouldn’t mind suggestions on what new songs I should check out and listen to. I’m not partial to any genre – literally. Do leave your suggestions in the comments below!                                                Hope you enjoyed the post! While I am a bit bummed about not being able to make it to the Sula Fest this year on the 6th & 7th of Feb, there was a sliver of joy when I got to know that VERO MODA was having a cool pre-party at their Delhi store in DLF Place Saket and I couldn’t miss it ofcourse.What I fancied most about the event was the entirety of the concept. They had the fusion band Advaita performing live at the store for about 2 hours while anybody and everybody could visit the store and go about their shopping experience and Sula was also serving some chilled wine and cheese at the store. Pretty, delicate tops with lovely hand-embroidery and silhouettes that can be worn easily for the entire day.While by themselves, Ether pieces give off a feminine vibe, I instinctively paired a lovely white top with my grey high-waisted denims & black booties for a edgier look. Finished it off with dark stained lips, my faux septum ring and big ass retro sunglasses. Hope you like the look! Pretty, delicate tops with lovely hand-embroidery and silhouettes that can be worn easily for the entire day.While by themselves, Ether pieces give off a feminine vibe, I instinctively paired a lovely white top with my grey high-waisted denims & black booties for a edgier look. Finished it off with dark stained lips, my faux septum ring and big ass retro sunglasses. Hope you like the look! I don’t really make resolutions because that just sounds a little lame and probably encourages you to procrastinate. Rather, I write down a list of things I’d like to have accomplished. I even cut out pictures from magazines and stick those too – places I’d like to plan my trips to, changes in diet and health, new habits I’d like to adopt. I know it’s cheesy but I also write down how much money I’d like to have in my bank account by the end of the year haahaa! I’m cooky that way.Infact I am not taking on any new work after this post goes live till the New Year. So a typical Holiday afternoon for me would be roasting a chicken, or finding tasty treats and quiet corners in Delhi where I can enjoy a coffee and keep browsing my pinterest. The Delhi Baking Company at JW Marriott is ideal for this. Evenings are for family-time and drinks. Naina has just concocted a delicious hot spiced brandy from what I hear so I can’t wait to see her next. Outfits tend to lean toward shimmery and shiny – not in your face bling but festive nonetheless. With big, fuzzy and warm coats. Here’s an outfit and a setting that is perfect for my days right now. There is literally no other time in the year quite like Christmas time. I even get the feeling sometimes that it may have gotten bigger than Diwali in the past few years but that could just be me. If so, it has probably got to do with the waves of western influence and commercialization. But that’s not what this post is about. This post is about happily giving in to the cheer of Christmas. It is definitely the time of the year when my chocolate consumption spikes much to the dismay of my skin. Cookies, candy, cakes, hot cocoa, coffees and more cake! I start looking at recipes for chicken roasts and fudgy cookies on pinterest because that’s only what you’ll find along with shiny happy DIYs, party makeup tutorials and party dressing – and I embrace it all with open arms!With the New Year closing in, I also have to start thinking about what I want to do next year. I don’t really make resolutions because that just sounds a little lame and probably encourages you to procrastinate. Rather, I write down a list of things I’d like to have accomplished. I even cut out pictures from magazines and stick those too – places I’d like to plan my trips to, changes in diet and health, new habits I’d like to adopt. I know it’s cheesy but I also write down how much money I’d like to have in my bank account by the end of the year haahaa! I’m cooky that way.Infact I am not taking on any new work after this post goes live till the New Year. So a typical Holiday afternoon for me would be roasting a chicken, or finding tasty treats and quiet corners in Delhi where I can enjoy a coffee and keep browsing my pinterest. The Delhi Baking Company at JW Marriott is ideal for this. Evenings are for family-time and drinks. Naina has just concocted a delicious hot spiced brandy from what I hear so I can’t wait to see her next. I had a slightly glam, yet day look in mind and the CaratLane jewellery went great with my winter outfit.The BeeJewelled Collection by CaratLane is a tribute to the wonders of honey-bees and the honeycomb. Born out of brilliant natural symmetry, the honeycomb has been the inspirational base for the designs of the jewellery pieces over which CaratLane has played with the balance of gold and scattering of finely cut diamonds. I am particularly a fan of their rings – some big enough to be cocktail rings yet with a fine and delicate body. Natural symmetry and fluid forms can strongly be sensed in all the designs which makes them easy to carry with a variety of looks. These pieces are equally suited for western as well as traditional Indian-wear. It was sheer coincidence that even the pattern on my dress was on similar lines as the honeycomb jewellery and it’s geometry!I recently got my hands on the fresh new ‘BeeJewelled’ collection by CaratLane and I couldn’t wait to wear some of the pretty pieces out for a late afternoon gig I had planned at Fio Cookhouse. I am particularly a fan of their rings – some big enough to be cocktail rings yet with a fine and delicate body. Natural symmetry and fluid forms can strongly be sensed in all the designs which makes them easy to carry with a variety of looks. These pieces are equally suited for western as well as traditional Indian-wear. It was sheer coincidence that even the pattern on my dress was on similar lines as the honeycomb jewellery and it’s geometry!Hope you guys enjoy this look I put together for a late, formal lunch. When you know you will have to spend that kind of time on a bike…I recently got my hands on the fresh new ‘BeeJewelled’ collection by CaratLane and I couldn’t wait to wear some of the pretty pieces out for a late afternoon gig I had planned at Fio Cookhouse. I had a slightly glam, yet day look in mind and the CaratLane jewellery went great with my winter outfit.The BeeJewelled Collection by CaratLane is a tribute to the wonders of honey-bees and the honeycomb. Born out of brilliant natural symmetry, the honeycomb has been the inspirational base for the designs of the jewellery pieces over which CaratLane has played with the balance of gold and scattering of finely cut diamonds. I am particularly a fan of their rings – some big enough to be cocktail rings yet with a fine and delicate body. Natural symmetry and fluid forms can strongly be sensed in all the designs which makes them easy to carry with a variety of looks. These pieces are equally suited for western as well as traditional Indian-wear. It was sheer coincidence that even the pattern on my dress was on similar lines as the honeycomb jewellery and it’s geometry!Hope you guys enjoy this look I put together for a late, formal lunch.            This pendant is so mesmerizing! It was my favorite piece from the BeeJewelled Collection. While I try to keep my sugar intake as limited as possible, the festive season really has a way with me (I don’t seem to mind either).Burberry has some fabulous festive pieces in store that would be incredible giftables for your special ones or heck even yourself! I browsed through their store in DLF Emporio to come up with a look that is festive, happy, incredibly hot and cozy at the same time and pretty much Christmas in an outfit! And you truly do feel like the queen of hearts literally wearing those cute red hearts on that cashmere scarf!A wonderful meal at ‘Pluck’ at the new Pullman Hotel in Aerocity and a quick shoot on their poolside really put me in vacay-mood. Hope you like the outfit! You can find the entire look at the Burberry store.Warm fuzzy feels to everyone! I do feel the cold than the others and definitely more than the boys. A total tropical baby, I was made for the beaches, not the bone-aching cold. So how do I cope with the winters? I switch on my oil-radiator room heater, get inside my cozy blanket and stay in my room for the next few winter months. AND NEVER COME OUT. Especially for any night plans. No that never happens with me. Friends don’t see me in the winters and eventually forget i’m in the same city – and I like it that way.But I still do crave my share of the winter sun. Basking under it is a truly special gift where you can remove most of your layers and feel the warmth penetrating the suffocating Delhi pollution and reaching your skin. The sunny days are the ones I cherish most during this time. The combination of a large over-sized white shirt and classic blue denims is literally the best thing to have happened to fashion before all the bullshit and it will NEVER go out of style. Atleast for me. And the cherry on top is the boyish denim jacket that is back too! So much better than all those fitted ones that leave you breathless and stiff in your shoulders. Sure they do have a certain charisma about them but I cannot imagine spending an entire day in them.                  I have officially declared the winters. Being a blogger, you learn to make the flatlay your best friend since, after personal pictures, it is flatlays that garner most engagement in my opinion. Plus it is so much fun to try out different permutations and combinations and looks of the flatlay. It’s quite addictive! This is what I quickly formed on the table. What do you think?       There was also a Spin-The-Wheel where you could take part and win prizes. The most popular spot with the shoppers.       In another corner they had Tin Caricatures where you had to sit down for about 10 minutes and a caricaturist would quickly draw your face on a legit Fossil tin box! This was super fun too! And who wouldn’t like to have their very own personalized Fossil tin with their caricature drawn on it?! What do you think of my caricature? After this we walked some more and that’s how we pretty much spent our entire afternoon – people watching, drinking beer, tree gazing and sunning. You can also spot the Statue of Liberty from the park so I did a little jump when I realised what I was seeing. Oliver Rousteing, the creative director of the Parisian couture house has created clothes in which you know you can rule the night – with strong shoulders, cinching high-waisted belts and accessories & embellishments that have no competition. A lot of the hand-work and embellishing has actually been done in India and some of the pieces have taken over 45 days to be created. It’s almost a pieces of art that you will own. To give you an idea of the price point of the collection, I have also mentioned the price of all the pieces that are a part of my look at the end of the post.I shot this look at the lovely JW Marriott property in Aerocity, New Delhi and picked out some of my favorite styles from the collection to make this look. That dress originally comes with a pair of palazzo pants but can be worn separately as just a dress. I combined it with a menswear jacket that has a very ‘piloty’ feel to it. A bright red clutch for some contrast, chunky gold-tipped boots, lots of rings and a pair of clip-on earrings and sunglasses. Yup, those are clip-ons. I explored a lot more of the collection which I has shared on my Snapchat a few days back. So add me on Snapchat so that you don’t miss any of the future action. ID: akanksharedhu Enjoy the look and all the best for the 5th! H&M’s newly opened, first store in India at Select Citywalk will witness the launch of the Balmain x H&M collection on November 5th, 2015 and as far as the eye can see, people are waiting for it with bated breath. So get your money ready honey because it’ll be gone before you can say #HMBalmaination.The collection has the intrinsic ‘Balmain’ feel to it with power-woman silhouettes and dripping with specific embellishments. Customizable jewelry is my favorite kind! It’s no surprise that I was very excited to explore and try out the fresh new ‘Palette’ Collection by Tanishq where you can change a ring in 36 different ways to suit your mood, occasion or just because you can. Yes, thats right – 36.       I also do love the way they have so aptly named the collection – ‘Palette’ because, much like an artist’s palette, you can play with different colors. It is literally the most versatile ring out there. With patented Swedish design and technology that is simple to understand and equally fun and easy to play around with, the ‘Palette’ Collection has be specifically created for Indian women who love colors and more than colors, love changing their looks and tastes.              You have 9 gemstones to pick from – Blue Topaz, Madeira Citrine, Green Topaz, Red Garnet, Lemon Quartz, Amethyst, Cognac Quartz, Pink Amethyst and Black Onyx. You have the option of a yellow or white gold ring shank and 3 different lock rings – yellow & yellow, white & pink or white & white. It all sounds a bit complicated but one look at it and it all just comes to you super easy. I have also shown a step by step guide of how to change from one gemstone to another later on in the post. Since these rings are so lovely on their own, I have paired them with a gorgeous white linen dress by ILK to keep the look light and summery.                                     Customizable jewelry is my favorite kind! It’s no surprise that I was very excited to explore and try out the fresh new ‘Palette’ Collection by Tanishq where you can change a ring in 36 different ways to suit your mood, occasion or just because you can. Yes, thats right – 36.       I also do love the way they have so aptly named the collection – ‘Palette’ because, much like an artist’s palette, you can play with different colors. It is literally the most versatile ring out there. With patented Swedish design and technology that is simple to understand and equally fun and easy to play around with, the ‘Palette’ Collection has be specifically created for Indian women who love colors and more than colors, love changing their looks and tastes.              You have 9 gemstones to pick from – Blue Topaz, Madeira Citrine, Green Topaz, Red Garnet, Lemon Quartz, Amethyst, Cognac Quartz, Pink Amethyst and Black Onyx. You have the option of a yellow or white gold ring shank and 3 different lock rings – yellow & yellow, white & pink or white & white. It all sounds a bit complicated but one look at it and it all just comes to you super easy. I have also shown a step by step guide of how to change from one gemstone to another later on in the post. Its difficult to restrain yourself from playing with it like its a toy sometimes!              See how I have worn some of my favorite colors from the ‘Palette’ Collection. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to change a gemstone or ring shank of the ring. Take your ring and admire it for a bit.        Then when you are finally ready to bring in a new gemstone, twist the lock ring.        Remove the gemstone from the setting.        Remove the lock ring if you need to change that as well.        Pick out the gemstone that you would like to place in the ring.        Place the lock ring first. Then put in the new gemstone. And you are DONE! Easy-peasy. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to change a gemstone or ring shank of the ring. Take your ring and admire it for a bit.        Then when you are finally ready to bring in a new gemstone, twist the lock ring.        Remove the gemstone from the setting.        Remove the lock ring if you need to change that as well.        Pick out the gemstone that you would like to place in the ring.        Place the lock ring first. Then put in the new gemstone. And you are DONE! Easy-peasy.             Hope you enjoyed the post! Since I had played with colors in my look on all the days, I decided to go back to just a black & white look on Day 05. Black & white do happen to be my favorite non-colors so I combined them in this total Kenneth Cole look that I wore with the Dior ‘So Real’ sunglasses and this septum ring that I had ordered online and had been waiting to get delivered forever. It finally came in a day before and no force of nature could have stopped me from wearing it that day. And I love it! But the main reason why I think it works is the dark red lip color. The lip color has a big role to play in whether the septum ring will suit your face or not so it’s a good idea to try some colors and see what you like it best with. It finally came in a day before and no force of nature could have stopped me from wearing it that day. And I love it! But the main reason why I think it works is the dark red lip color. The lip color has a big role to play in whether the septum ring will suit your face or not so it’s a good idea to try some colors and see what you like it best with. A gold septum ring and dark red lips is a go-to combination and you can’t go wrong with it. How many times have you heard beauty products making promises…September 24, 2014Yesterday turned out to be a very hectic but super pumped-up day. And the highlight of the day was the Anamika Khanna show sponsored by Spaces – Home & Beyond. This was Anamika’s very first RTW show and everybody had been eagerly waiting for it.       From Day01 of #AIFWSS16, I had been exploring the different kiosks set up by Spaces – Home & Beyond at he venue and their super comfortable lounge as well. There was actually a time where I went and relaxed for a bit on the bed in their lounge and sipped on some wine. And the most fun was their turban kiosk where you can wear a turban of theirs and click a selfie and they display it on their screen during fashion week. Hahaah! That turban suits me quite well don’t you think?!                         Parineeti Chopra had also visited the Spaces – Home & Beyond lounge on Day 02 and it was nice to chat up with her for a bit.       I was quite excited to see the injection of sport in Anamika’s collection. Since I’m currently loving wearing sneakers with just about everything – even dresses. There were sneakers with sarees and bindis worn with caps during the show and the 2 parallel stripes that were predominant in many palazzos gave a very ‘Adidas’ vibe. It wasn’t sporty-luxe in a way that you’d want to wear it on a yatch but just sublimely easy silhouettes, wispy textures and sudden deep colors in a few pieces. And I relate quite well with RTW since these are styles that you can actually wear. It has in-fact been adopted by a lot of big labels as a very individualistic style and is being celebrated everywhere. While some people still cling on to the old notions of it being a complete gypsy look, you can literally evolve it around your own aesthetic preferences – like I have here. You will find details of the 1st one HERE and this blog post is all about the second one that we booked through Airbnb. I would love to share a few of my personal tips that I have learnt from my Airbnb experience in New York.Living through Airbnb has opened up the world to me. It has made possible living in places where you don’t even have hotels. How exciting is that! And so suitable for business travel and even family vacations. Doesn’t matter whether you are travelling alone, how long you need to stay in a place and what the purpose of your visit is – there is bound to be an Airbnb place meant exactly for you.I received so many queries from people on instagram asking me the details of the Airbnb apartments that Naina & I have been putting up in. You will find details of the 1st one HERE and this blog post is all about the second one that we booked through Airbnb. I would love to share a few of my personal tips that I have learnt from my Airbnb experience in New York.–>  Living in a new city through Airbnb has definitely been a more homely and real experience. With so much more warmth and genuine help from the hosts – you cannot get this kind of interaction in hotels. The hosts try their best to make your stay as comfortable as possible (ofcourse we made sure we booked listings with recognized hosts who had been given the ‘super-host’ badges) so it is a very customizable way of living as well. You get to pick out exactly the conditions and options you want and are looking for, whether it be the whole house to yourself for more privacy or sharing the property with the host if you like interaction and better tips for exploring a new place. Everything is specified and it is upto you to choose what facilities and neighborhoods you are interested in. –>  Our stay in New York was both for leisure and work and Airbnb turned out to be a great choice. We got to explore different parts of New York and for work, during New York Fashion Week, we chose exactly where we wanted to be and stayed close to where all the action was. At this point a hotel would not even have been possible since there are no hotels in that area. Also, in comparison, we would have been confined to just a room in a hotel whereas here we had a entire house to ourselves. –>  It is always a good idea to take the initiative to get in touch with a host before booking their listing to clear out the tiniest doubts you may have. Contacting the host also gives you an idea of how pro-active they are depending on how quickly they respond to your queries. –> Another great tip is to take the time out to read most if not all the reviews a particular listing has on Airbnb. That gives you the best idea of what the actual place and host are like. I ALWAYS read ALL the reviews. –>  In a city like New York where the public transport is so widely used AND safe, if you know that you are going to be using the subway a lot, before booking a listing, make sure you know how far the closest subway station will be from the property. It can end up saving a lot of time over your entire trip. All details are marked on the map. And again, if in doubt, just ask the host how far the station really is. Sometimes, the property is not marked exactly where it is located on the map. Knowing where the closest grocery store is located will also help you out. –>  Never feel shy of asking even the tiniest questions from your would-be host, even if you feel like you are beginning to sound annoying. You are paying your hard earned money to stay in their house and have all the rights to know exactly what you want to know before deciding to spend that money. And if the host does get annoyed, well then you probably shouldn’t book their place! –>  Airbnb has a super-responsive and helpful team worldwide, so incase of any sort of problem you can always shoot them an email or call them and they try to resolve the issue in the best possible way and time as they can. –> The world is your oyster and Airbnb is truly a great tool for exploring it, one city at a time.Living through Airbnb has opened up the world to me. It has made possible living in places where you don’t even have hotels. How exciting is that! And so suitable for business travel and even family vacations. I ALWAYS read ALL the reviews. –>  In a city like New York where the public transport is so widely used AND safe, if you know that you are going to be using the subway a lot, before booking a listing, make sure you know how far the closest subway station will be from the property. It can end up saving a lot of time over your entire trip. All details are marked on the map. And again, if in doubt, just ask the host how far the station really is. Sometimes, the property is not marked exactly where it is located on the map. Knowing where the closest grocery store is located will also help you out. –>  Never feel shy of asking even the tiniest questions from your would-be host, even if you feel like you are beginning to sound annoying. You are paying your hard earned money to stay in their house and have all the rights to know exactly what you want to know before deciding to spend that money. And if the host does get annoyed, well then you probably shouldn’t book their place! –>  Airbnb has a super-responsive and helpful team worldwide, so incase of any sort of problem you can always shoot them an email or call them and they try to resolve the issue in the best possible way and time as they can. –> The world is your oyster and Airbnb is truly a great tool for exploring it, one city at a time.I have already scouted out houses on Airbnb for my next girls-only trip!Living through Airbnb has opened up the world to me. The host, Suzanne had a very neat diary of her personal suggestions of what restaurants to try out nearby and other general pointers which was such a nice gesture for any out-of-towner. There were 2 grocery/ general stores withing 3 minutes walking from our place out of which one was a 24/7 one. Yes to fresh fruits ALL the time!                               Living through Airbnb has opened up the world to me. It has made possible living in places where you don’t even have hotels. How exciting is that! And so suitable for business travel and even family vacations. Doesn’t matter whether you are travelling alone, how long you need to stay in a place and what the purpose of your visit is – there is bound to be an Airbnb place meant exactly for you.I received so many queries from people on instagram asking me the details of the Airbnb apartments that Naina & I have been putting up in. You will find details of the 1st one HERE and this blog post is all about the second one that we booked through Airbnb. I would love to share a few of my personal tips that I have learnt from my Airbnb experience in New York.–>  Living in a new city through Airbnb has definitely been a more homely and real experience. With so much more warmth and genuine help from the hosts – you cannot get this kind of interaction in hotels. The hosts try their best to make your stay as comfortable as possible (ofcourse we made sure we booked listings with recognized hosts who had been given the ‘super-host’ badges) so it is a very customizable way of living as well. You get to pick out exactly the conditions and options you want and are looking for, whether it be the whole house to yourself for more privacy or sharing the property with the host if you like interaction and better tips for exploring a new place. Everything is specified and it is upto you to choose what facilities and neighborhoods you are interested in. –>  Our stay in New York was both for leisure and work and Airbnb turned out to be a great choice. We got to explore different parts of New York and for work, during New York Fashion Week, we chose exactly where we wanted to be and stayed close to where all the action was. At this point a hotel would not even have been possible since there are no hotels in that area. Also, in comparison, we would have been confined to just a room in a hotel whereas here we had a entire house to ourselves. –>  It is always a good idea to take the initiative to get in touch with a host before booking their listing to clear out the tiniest doubts you may have. Contacting the host also gives you an idea of how pro-active they are depending on how quickly they respond to your queries. –> Another great tip is to take the time out to read most if not all the reviews a particular listing has on Airbnb. That gives you the best idea of what the actual place and host are like. I ALWAYS read ALL the reviews. –>  In a city like New York where the public transport is so widely used AND safe, if you know that you are going to be using the subway a lot, before booking a listing, make sure you know how far the closest subway station will be from the property. It can end up saving a lot of time over your entire trip. All details are marked on the map. And again, if in doubt, just ask the host how far the station really is. Sometimes, the property is not marked exactly where it is located on the map. Knowing where the closest grocery store is located will also help you out. –>  Never feel shy of asking even the tiniest questions from your would-be host, even if you feel like you are beginning to sound annoying. You are paying your hard earned money to stay in their house and have all the rights to know exactly what you want to know before deciding to spend that money. And if the host does get annoyed, well then you probably shouldn’t book their place! –>  Airbnb has a super-responsive and helpful team worldwide, so incase of any sort of problem you can always shoot them an email or call them and they try to resolve the issue in the best possible way and time as they can. –> The world is your oyster and Airbnb is truly a great tool for exploring it, one city at a time.I have already scouted out houses on Airbnb for my next girls-only trip!       Our second apartment was located int he heart of Wall Street in NYC extremely close to the Stock Exchange! Living on Wall St was a very different experience from the Lower East Side before this. Narrower streets, mostly office-goers, very busy during the day and quite calm in the evenings, skyscrapers everywhere you look. One of the biggest advantages we had was that fashion week was starting and the subway station was literally across the street from our building. The Wall St area has a larger concentration of subway stations as compared to Ludlow St where they were scattered a bit away from each other. At this point a hotel would not even have been possible since there are no hotels in that area. Also, in comparison, we would have been confined to just a room in a hotel whereas here we had a entire house to ourselves. –>  It is always a good idea to take the initiative to get in touch with a host before booking their listing to clear out the tiniest doubts you may have. Contacting the host also gives you an idea of how pro-active they are depending on how quickly they respond to your queries. –> Another great tip is to take the time out to read most if not all the reviews a particular listing has on Airbnb. That gives you the best idea of what the actual place and host are like. I ALWAYS read ALL the reviews. –>  In a city like New York where the public transport is so widely used AND safe, if you know that you are going to be using the subway a lot, before booking a listing, make sure you know how far the closest subway station will be from the property. It can end up saving a lot of time over your entire trip. All details are marked on the map. And again, if in doubt, just ask the host how far the station really is. Sometimes, the property is not marked exactly where it is located on the map. Knowing where the closest grocery store is located will also help you out. –>  Never feel shy of asking even the tiniest questions from your would-be host, even if you feel like you are beginning to sound annoying. You are paying your hard earned money to stay in their house and have all the rights to know exactly what you want to know before deciding to spend that money. And if the host does get annoyed, well then you probably shouldn’t book their place! –>  Airbnb has a super-responsive and helpful team worldwide, so incase of any sort of problem you can always shoot them an email or call them and they try to resolve the issue in the best possible way and time as they can. –> The world is your oyster and Airbnb is truly a great tool for exploring it, one city at a time.I have already scouted out houses on Airbnb for my next girls-only trip!       Our second apartment was located int he heart of Wall Street in NYC extremely close to the Stock Exchange! Living on Wall St was a very different experience from the Lower East Side before this. Narrower streets, mostly office-goers, very busy during the day and quite calm in the evenings, skyscrapers everywhere you look. One of the biggest advantages we had was that fashion week was starting and the subway station was literally across the street from our building. The Wall St area has a larger concentration of subway stations as compared to Ludlow St where they were scattered a bit away from each other.             Our apartment was a very cozy and well kept one. With everything in place, extra amenities and the most cushion-y bed I have ever felt! The host, Suzanne had a very neat diary of her personal suggestions of what restaurants to try out nearby and other general pointers which was such a nice gesture for any out-of-towner. There were 2 grocery/ general stores withing 3 minutes walking from our place out of which one was a 24/7 one. Yes to fresh fruits ALL the time!                                                  Our regular pit stop before heading out to fashion week for a coffee and a quick pick-me-up sandwich was the Financier which was a minutes walk from our building. Then, hop on to the subway towards all the fashion-action. Our week whizzed by so so fast and before we could hashtag all our insta updates, it was time for us to move out! Boo!              On one of our free days we walked over to Battery Park which was a 10 minute walk from our apartment. What a gorgeous day it was for a walk in the park. Slightly on the hotter side but nothing we Indians can’t handle! Can you just look at that gorgeous view!!!        It is a lovely walk along the water through Battery Park.              And another day we walked to the other side towards another well known restaurant – Nelson Blue which, to our pleasant surprise had a lovely view of the Brooklyn Bridge! I cannot get over how fabulous the views in this city are – IN ALL DIRECTIONS!!!       Coffee and Spicy Calamari at Nelson Blue              On the walk to Nelson Blue.       Living through Airbnb has opened up the world to me. It has made possible living in places where you don’t even have hotels. How exciting is that! And so suitable for business travel and even family vacations. Doesn’t matter whether you are travelling alone, how long you need to stay in a place and what the purpose of your visit is – there is bound to be an Airbnb place meant exactly for you.I received so many queries from people on instagram asking me the details of the Airbnb apartments that Naina & I have been putting up in. You will find details of the 1st one HERE and this blog post is all about the second one that we booked through Airbnb. I would love to share a few of my personal tips that I have learnt from my Airbnb experience in New York.–>  Living in a new city through Airbnb has definitely been a more homely and real experience. With so much more warmth and genuine help from the hosts – you cannot get this kind of interaction in hotels. The hosts try their best to make your stay as comfortable as possible (ofcourse we made sure we booked listings with recognized hosts who had been given the ‘super-host’ badges) so it is a very customizable way of living as well. You get to pick out exactly the conditions and options you want and are looking for, whether it be the whole house to yourself for more privacy or sharing the property with the host if you like interaction and better tips for exploring a new place. Everything is specified and it is upto you to choose what facilities and neighborhoods you are interested in. –>  Our stay in New York was both for leisure and work and Airbnb turned out to be a great choice. We got to explore different parts of New York and for work, during New York Fashion Week, we chose exactly where we wanted to be and stayed close to where all the action was. At this point a hotel would not even have been possible since there are no hotels in that area. Also, in comparison, we would have been confined to just a room in a hotel whereas here we had a entire house to ourselves. –>  It is always a good idea to take the initiative to get in touch with a host before booking their listing to clear out the tiniest doubts you may have. Contacting the host also gives you an idea of how pro-active they are depending on how quickly they respond to your queries. –> Another great tip is to take the time out to read most if not all the reviews a particular listing has on Airbnb. That gives you the best idea of what the actual place and host are like. I ALWAYS read ALL the reviews. –>  In a city like New York where the public transport is so widely used AND safe, if you know that you are going to be using the subway a lot, before booking a listing, make sure you know how far the closest subway station will be from the property. It can end up saving a lot of time over your entire trip. All details are marked on the map. And again, if in doubt, just ask the host how far the station really is. Sometimes, the property is not marked exactly where it is located on the map. Knowing where the closest grocery store is located will also help you out. –>  Never feel shy of asking even the tiniest questions from your would-be host, even if you feel like you are beginning to sound annoying. You are paying your hard earned money to stay in their house and have all the rights to know exactly what you want to know before deciding to spend that money. And if the host does get annoyed, well then you probably shouldn’t book their place! –>  Airbnb has a super-responsive and helpful team worldwide, so incase of any sort of problem you can always shoot them an email or call them and they try to resolve the issue in the best possible way and time as they can. –> The world is your oyster and Airbnb is truly a great tool for exploring it, one city at a time.I have already scouted out houses on Airbnb for my next girls-only trip! Then on our last day at that Lower East Side apartment, after one too many suggestions we FINALLY decided to go inside the restaurant and try their iconic Pastrami Sandwiches before moving to our next Airbnb place. And YAAAS for that decision! There isn’t much to the sandwich really but sweet baby cow it’s delicious!!! (No offense to the vegetarians out there. You may not want to scroll down because I have some really tempting close-ups of the meat in the sandwich. It was THAT tasty.)Honestly, before hearing about Katz’s, I didn’t even know what pastrami is (Like I said, not a food blogger). So what is Pastrami? It is actually an old method of preserving meat, before refrigeration came about. But now, it’s a fancy sandwich, which if you don’t eat at Katz’s while you’re in New York, you’re basically losing at life. No, I’m kidding, there is a lot more to eat, see and do in NYC but if you like pastrami and have googled it at any point in time, you might wanna try eating one here. Back to pastrami, it’s raw beef that is partially dried, highly seasoned and herbed and then smoked and steamed for your pleasure. The pastrami by Katz’s is supposed to be cured even more slowly and without any extra chemicals, water or additives. And by slower I mean almost a month!! And I basically snorted that sandwich in 5 minutes. Thank you Katz’s!A tip for first timers, they only take cash. No cards! I also quite enjoyed the whole diner/deli neon signage inside the restaurant. But I do not like aereated drinks so didn’t order a coke or pepsi with the sandwich. Just lots and lots of pickles! Spent a lovely day at Bryant Park in New York City at the beginning of our trip. Right now I’m sitting in our Brooklyn Airbnb apartment on a Sunday drafting the blog post. Some days you just have to work. New York has been an amazing experience. In many ways it is just another big city but in many ways it’s really special. You can walk endlessly here and never be bored. Back home in Delhi the idea of walking on the streets wearing what I wear here at the times I walk around only makes me shudder. Besides, the skies are just so blue here. It’s like even the clouds are happy and full of joy being in Manhattan!My time in New York is inching to an end and I don’t even want to begin thinking about my painfully long flight back home. It is a 13 or 14 hour long flight to Dubai. Then I have an 8 hour stop over in Dubai (There is only so much Duty Free scanning and shopping I can think of). And then a 3 hour flight to Delhi. Oh well! If you have any cool product suggestions for Duty Free please do share with me so that I can check them out.Back to Bryant Park, they have free Wifi here. Plenty of pretty tables to sit under the gorgeous green trees, open grass if you want to strip to your kini and get some sun and tall buildings all around. My outfit is just an all-white look with my really old but fav denim jacket and a statement necklace that is my only recent purchase. Most of the clothes I packed for New York are all my old clothes barring a few pieces that designer Cameron Kham was lovely enough to send across for my trip and my Vero Moda outfit. All the outfits that I will be sharing subsequently with you will make you realized how just carrying classic pieces can give you so many options of good, evergreen style. VERO MODA can also be found on Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | Pinterest Stay connected with me over Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | Pinterest |*{ client }As the last show for NYFW SS16 that I attended this season (also my first ever NYFW!!), the Bibhu Mohapatra runway show was the perfect ending for me! An absolutely stunning collection, impeccable surface ornamentation, flawless silhouettes and execution. The Spring 2016 collection was inspired by the life of Annemarie Schwarzenbach, who was a writer, traveler, photographer and journalist from Zurich. She mostly dressed in menswear and was a style icon of the Bauhaus era. Which is why you can also spot some Bauhaus influence in the collection in the form of motifs, lines, geometric shapes and surface embellishments. Delicious silks, crepes, leather, jacquard and neoprene were most of the materials used. All pieces are exquisitely form-flattering and luscious. Which is why you can also spot some Bauhaus influence in the collection in the form of motifs, lines, geometric shapes and surface embellishments. The seating…September 11, 2015In "Events"The NYFW runway show that I attended today was Francesca Liberatore at Skylight at Moynihan Station, NYC. Her collection was named ‘The Hear is the Centre’ and revolved around the different aspects a human heart can take up, not just the typical ‘romantic’ label that it gets but also other facets like obsession, desire, domination, devotion & more. Which is why the collection wasn’t your default feminine delicate stuff, it had infusions of strong silhouettes mixed with flowy silk chiffons and a few masculine details as well. There were also the literal human hearts in prints and embroideries and had been cleverly managed to not look macabre at all. I quite liked it! Aptly so because the name of their SS16 collection is ‘Momentum’. The Chromat label was formed by Becca McCharen and draws heavily from her architechture and urban design background. The collection of this Seoul based label by Kathleen Kye drew heavy visual inspiration from the electric K-Pop scene. K-Pop is short for Korean pop and is a musical genre that originated in South Korea that has very characteristic audio-visual elements. Built on that, KYE had a lot of street silhouettes with bright candy colors that were punctuated with basic blacks and hints of metal accents. Definitely new-age and young. My personal favorites were the ‘HATE’ emblems on some of the pieces, the metallic maxi dress with a huge heart-shaped cut out at the back, the army jacket and the statement sunglasses that the models were wearing. A lot of energy and crisp direction in the collection as well as the show! LOVE!       The KYE runway show at NYFW was kinetic, fun and pop. In collaboration with the Taiwan Tourism Bureau, Malan presented menswear and womenswear inspired by his recent travels to Taiwan’s Sun Moon Lake. The pieces incorporated  traditional Taiwanese dying techniques, embroideries, silks, and fibers merged with modern silhouettes. It was an elaborate setup with live music.The Malan Breton show was held at the splendid Gotham Hall in New York with Style Fashion Week. In collaboration with the Taiwan Tourism Bureau, Malan presented menswear and womenswear inspired by his recent travels to Taiwan’s Sun Moon Lake. The pieces incorporated  traditional Taiwanese dying techniques, embroideries, silks, and fibers merged with modern silhouettes. It was an elaborate setup with live music.My favorite part of the show was actually the menswear. Loved a lot of the pieces and would wear them too. The element of a hoodie to the blazers was interesting but didn’t completely appeal to me. There was a silk trench coat that I wanted to steal off from the model though!The Malan Breton show was held at the splendid Gotham Hall in New York with Style Fashion Week. In collaboration with the Taiwan Tourism Bureau, Malan presented menswear and womenswear inspired by his recent travels to Taiwan’s Sun Moon Lake. The pieces incorporated  traditional Taiwanese dying techniques, embroideries, silks, and fibers merged with modern silhouettes. It was an elaborate setup with live music.My favorite part of the show was actually the menswear. Loved a lot of the pieces and would wear them too. The element of a hoodie to the blazers was interesting but didn’t completely appeal to me. There was a silk trench coat that I wanted to steal off from the model though! The Malan Breton show was held at the splendid Gotham Hall in New York with Style Fashion Week. In collaboration with the Taiwan Tourism Bureau, Malan presented menswear and womenswear inspired by his recent travels to Taiwan’s Sun Moon Lake. The pieces incorporated  traditional Taiwanese dying techniques, embroideries, silks, and fibers merged with modern silhouettes. It was an elaborate setup with live music.My favorite part of the show was actually the menswear. Loved a lot of the pieces and would wear them too. The element of a hoodie to the blazers was interesting but didn’t completely appeal to me. There was a silk trench coat that I wanted to steal off from the model though! The Spring collection was inspired by elements you see, touch and feel at your home – grommets on a chair, texture of a pillow, mesh on a kitchen wall – all these details were interpreted into clothes with impeccable finishing and attention to detail.The presentation by Tess Giberson at NYFW took you right back at home! The Spring collection was inspired by elements you see, touch and feel at your home – grommets on a chair, texture of a pillow, mesh on a kitchen wall – all these details were interpreted into clothes with impeccable finishing and attention to detail.There were pretty inserts of crochet, macrame mixed with clean & graphic materials like coated mesh and laser-cut leather. Colors were kept simple with whites, creams, blacks, indigo and just a few pieces of stripes. The collection gave me a warm fuzzy feeling even though it was for Spring – probably because it really did remind me of a cozy day at a quiet beach with the ones I love. Comfort and ease. The Ohne Titel runway show for NYFW happened today at 7:00pm at Skylight at Clarkson Square, NYC. It drizzled the whole day but luckily we didn’t have to walk too much from the subway station at Houston St. That is what the crossing at Clarkson Sq looks like.       The seating at the show was extremely efficient and thankfully very well lit. A lot of the styles were delicate and perfect for spring but had a bit of edge in them. Sheer bands across formal pants, organza trench coats, bits of lace peeking out and beautiful narrow pleats in abundance. Think of flowy chiffon silhouettes, one-shoulder knit tops and a few fabulous chain & macrame fringe dresses. You will clearly be able to point out my favorite pieces because I have shared more than one photographs of those. You will clearly be able to point out my favorite pieces because I have shared more than one photographs of those.                                                                                                       A quick pit stop to the ladies-room post the show and back home to edit the day’s photographs.       Hope you enjoyed the post! #RedhuxNYCThe Ohne Titel runway show for NYFW happened today at 7:00pm at Skylight at Clarkson Square, NYC. It drizzled the whole day but luckily we didn’t have to walk too much from the subway station at Houston St. That is what the crossing at Clarkson Sq looks like.       The seating at the show was extremely efficient and thankfully very well lit. A lot of the styles were delicate and perfect for spring but had a bit of edge in them. Sheer bands across formal pants, organza trench coats, bits of lace peeking out and beautiful narrow pleats in abundance. Think of flowy chiffon silhouettes, one-shoulder knit tops and a few fabulous chain & macrame fringe dresses. You will clearly be able to point out my favorite pieces because I have shared more than one photographs of those. It’s a perfect place if you want to spend your day watching people walk by.                         We ate a staple brekkie of eggs, bananas, some more fruit, almonds & green tea that we all shopped from the close-by Whole Foods thanks to James’ tips.              The views from our apartment were UNBEATABLE. I still can’t believe we had them for a week.                   The other best part of the apartment was the rooftop terrace which was a perfect spot to soak up some sun, sit and stare at the views of NYC in the cool wind. You can easily spend your entire day here.            Our bedroom       The living area. Everything in the house was exactly as shown on Airbnb.       The fully equipped kitchen.       What a splendid first week we have had on our NYC trip this September! And Airbnb has played such a big part in it! It truly is a tool that makes life so much easier and travel so much better and stress-free. For our 1st week in NYC, Naina & I booked an apartment on the 23rd floor of a gorgeous building in the Lower East Side that gave us THE most spectacular views of the city we could have asked for. The views truly steal the ENTIRE show for this apartment, followed by how chilled out and great our host James was!       This was a 2 bedroom apartment that we shared with the host James and he was so helpful with recommending nearby places to check out, eat at, how to go about getting to places. It’s ironic that towards the end of our stay at his place, he left for Chennai for a friend’s wedding! That’s Naina & I with James on a sunny Saturday afternoon up on the roof terrace of the building.       The Lower East Side is such a vibrant neighbourhood! Between planning and organizing our calendar during NYFW, trying out new places to eat at, meeting up with friends and making new ones in the city, our 7 days sped by faster than you can type out #RedhuxNYC on your cellphone! James also has some wicked music set-up in his apartment.        Experiencing a new city or place through Airbnb is so different and sometimes even better than a hotel stay in my opinion. Firstly, the rents for a prime area are so much more affordable through Airbnb, you get free-wifi and the most important aspect is the social one. We got to interact with so many people including James and get a real feel of what life would probably be like if we were to live in NYC. I feel that you get better exposed to the local cultures and even end up making friends. On the other hand, the maximum interaction I have ever had while putting up in a hotel is when I’ve needed room-service or my key-card has stopped working which is truly dull. If you want to experience real living n a city, going grocery shopping, sun soaking on the roof terrace with the locals, finding the hidden gem of a coffee shop/ bar that won’t be listed in any books or websites, Airbnb is for you.What a splendid first week we have had on our NYC trip this September! I don’t just practice this asana during my yoga sessions, but I also do this when I wake up to get my blood moving and jump start my muscles. Anytime during the day when I can feel the tension building in my shoulders and neck this is my go-to pose. It really helps in relieving stress in your shoulder areas. The Uttanasana has a lot more benefits – all listed out later on in the post.Another reason the Standing Forward Bend Pose is so popular with me is because it doesn’t require any special preparation, no yoga mat, no yoga clothes, no lying down. While exhaling bend forward from your hips rather than the waist. ~  Slightly suck your tummy in while bending further and focus on lengthening the torso. ~  Knees should be kept straight and not bent. ~  You can place your fingertips or your palms on the floor beside your feet, or hold your big toes or hold the back of your ankles. ~  Try and point your buttocks to the sky, keep lengthening your torso and let your head, neck and shoulders be completely loose and free. ~  Stay in this posture for 30 seconds to a minute. ~  For coming back up, take the support of your hands on your hips, inhale and come up with a long front torso rather than rolling your spine back up.The Uttanasana or ‘Standing Forward Bend Pose’ is another great way to get a quick stretch at any time of the day for me. Virabhadra is the name of a fierce warrior, an incarnation of Shiva, described as having a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, and a thousand feet, wielding a thousand clubs, and wearing a tiger’s skin. And ‘Virabhadrasana is literally translated into the Virabhadra’s ( warrior’s ) asana ( pose ).This pose strengthens the legs, brings flexibility to the spinal muscles and tones the abdominal muscles. It helps in opening the hips and increasing the stamina. Personally, I also find that it helps me focus better and concentrate.      How To Do It:~  Stand straight. Inhale deeply and move your feet away from each other and extend your arms out to the side with palms facing the floor. ~  Turn the left foot out and the right foot in by around 15 degrees. ~  As you exhale, bend the left leg to 90 degrees keeping the right leg firm and straight. ~  Keep your arms extended and stretched in the opposite directions. ~  Open your chest, turn your head and look along the left arm. ~  Keep your chest open, relax your face and breathe normally. ~  Hold for 30-40 seconds, inhale and come up. ~  Repeat with the other side.While this asana is the second posture in the warrior poses, it is usually practiced first as it is less challenging. I have been told day-dreaming is bad (waste of time), I have read that day dreaming is great food for your mind and soul. Pretty much like anything else in life, people have come up with the good and bad side of day-dreaming. While I’m not standing behind either of those sides, I am only sharing my love for some serious day-dreaming today. I have been and still am a voracious day-dreamer. I can’t say for sure whether that has done me any good or bad. But what I do know is that I have enjoyed every second of doing it. Back in school, I used to imagine (okay, day-dream) that they would actually dedicate day-dream time for us kids or that it would eventually happen over the years. But, yes, I know, it hasn’t. We have, all, with a united agreement, moved towards the more material things in life. I still day-dream however. Which is why, when I spotted this dress, I knew it was going home with me. This look is a perfect example of my ‘Everyday Glam’. Off-the-hook sexy when I want it and yet wearable for even a casual day out.                   The Claudia Chandelier Earrings are the MOST stunning & versatile pair of earrings from the Showstoppers collection. These would definitely be my first choice not only because I can imagine wearing them with a wide variety of Indian as well as Western outfits but also because they are so perfectly crafted! If you have these in your wardrobe, you are never too far away from glam.
